title.rendered: Best strategy games for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Mobile gaming has often been associated with light-hearted games that help you pass the time when you’re either commuting or procrastinating. However, in the past few years, the progress of mobile technology has created a few welcome niches in mobile gaming. And one of the genres that stand out is Strategy games!

If you are looking for something more adventurous yet educational, strategy games for iPhone have you covered! I have listed some of the best strategy games for iPhone and iPad you’ll love to play. Let’s have a look.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Raiders of the North Sea
  • 2. DomiNations
  • 3. Sid Meier’s Civilization® VI
  • 4. Subterfuge
  • 5. FTL: Faster Than Light
  • 6. ROME: Total War
  • 7. Invisible, Inc.
  • 8. Fallout Shelter
  • 9. Plants vs. Zombies

1. Raiders of the North Sea

Raiders of the North Sea brings the classic elements from the physical board game into the digital world. Become a Viking raider in the Viking Age and plant raids on different communities to gather lost treasures.

The game’s objective is to raid for as many resources as possible and impress the Chieftain of your Viking clan. The more resources you have, the more Chieftain is impressed. With extra resources, you can also upgrade your crew and ship to go on more challenging raids.

The gameplay is turn-based, and the digital version animates the gameplay to a fair extent – you can see your ships glide across foreign waters as you plan to raid an unsuspecting community. You can also play the campaign mode to get a better idea of how the gameplay works. Once ready, you can play with friends online and compete for the most loot!

Price: $9.99

Download

2. DomiNations  

This is one of the best strategy games for iOS. Although it takes inspiration from a few of the greatest strategy games on different consoles, DomiNations puts its spin on it. It also has an immense amount of replayability.

The game tasks you to see through the progress of human civilization, starting from the tools in the Iron Age to the age of flying cars – the Space Age. While you oversee all of human history and progress, you also get to conduct raids and build empires of your own.

DomiNations has a few microtransactions, though. If you want to progress faster, you have to make some in-game purchases for leveling up or getting more resources. If you aren’t willing to spend money, you can still play the game without purchasing. However, your progress will be slower.

Regardless of microtransactions, this game is still an absolute joy to play. If you like your strategy games to give you decisive moments that will create a great impact in the latter stages of your campaign, DomiNations is for you!

Price: Free (In app-purchase starts from $0.99)

Download  

3. Sid Meier’s Civilization® VI 

Sid Meier’s Civilization games have been the cornerstone of strategy games on video game consoles for a long time. Now, this powerhouse of a strategy game is available on iOS as well.

The game has been ported over to mobile devices, but it does not leave any bells and whistles. It is the full game, as gorgeous as you can find it on a laptop or a gaming PC. With a steep learning curve and vastly deep gameplay mechanics, Civilization VI is one of the best war strategy games for iPhone and iPad.

In Civilization VI, you control the way human beings progress through time. From building empires to establishing corporate structures in a dystopian future, you can do it all. It has turn-based gameplay, and you can gather resources to build your settlement either through war or political connections.

It is a race towards becoming the most advanced community in the world. The maps on which you can play the game are also quite large, meaning that there’s a fair bit of exploring here.

If you’re already a fan of Sid Meier’s strategy games and Civilization VI on gaming consoles, this game is a must-play for your mobile device. You will have to purchase the game after playing 60 rounds, but the price is worth it.

Price: Free

Download

4. Subterfuge

A war strategy game, Subterfuge takes command over bases and submarines as you try to manage your resources to survive the war.

The game changes the mechanics of war strategy games. Instead of matches that last for a single play session, the matches in Subterfuge are drawn out far longer.

When you issue a command over your base or submarines, the instructions will be carried out over hours in real-time. Basically, as a player, you have to think a few steps ahead of your opponents and track how long it takes for the game to carry out your orders.

As a strategy game, the mechanics are quite complex. You will have to invest a fair amount of time in understanding how the game works and what your playstyle or method of diplomacy in the game could be. Some modifiers can add to your war force. However, the boosts they provide to your bases or submarines are temporary.

Price: Free (In app-purchase starts from $0.99)

Download  

5. FTL: Faster Than Light

When Faster Than Light was released on PC in 2012, it took the gaming community by storm. Its addictive gameplay was combined with a rewarding challenge-based progression system that fans adored.

With its release for Apple devices, you can now enjoy this award-winning game at your fingertips. You’re tasked with running your spaceship as you try to save the galaxy. You also have to manage your crew and battle with hostile forces along the way.

The game has eight sectors. It has a procedurally generated system. This means that the game adapts to your actions and generates levels and events in the game based on your actions. Hence, the game’s events won’t be the same for most players.

A playthrough of the game will end if you lose your crew members or your ship is destroyed. In such a scenario, you have to start the game once again. Faster Than Light also includes a good amount of combat and diplomacy.

Price: $9.99

Download

6. ROME: Total War

Rome: Total War was initially released to the PC and received rave reviews for its strategy-based gameplay and storyline. Now, it’s been ported to mobile devices to enjoy the famous series at your fingertips.

The game also brings in the various expansion packs available on the PC game. Rome: Total War gives you the task of commanding one of the greatest armies in history. Guide the Roman army towards victory as you craft an empire from the spoils of war.

Fans of the game’s PC version will understand the need for tactical expertise as you micro-manage every aspect of your army. From the resources required to operate the entire army to the build of each army unit, you will have to supervise these areas both before the start and during the battle.

There are also a few campaigns you can play. During those, you will have to manage the economic and civil aspects of your empire. These points are crucial as they will help strengthen your empire and army. As you keep facing tougher opponents, you will have to upgrade your army as well.

Price: $9.99

Download

7. Invisible, Inc.

Invisible, Inc. is a perfect example of incorporating a unique idea onto a standard strategy game to create something new. Its take on a dystopian future is something rarely seen in mobile games.

The game takes the setting of a dystopian future where mega-corporations are ruling the world. These corporations use a database monitoring people working and living under them.

You, as a player, are put in the shoes of a group of spies and specialists whose objectives are to loot as many resources as possible and ultimately live off the grid. In your bid to escape from the prying eyes of these corporations, you must direct the agents as they try to pull off unbelievable heists. Every successful heist can damage corporations.

Invisible, Inc. also provides different agents to control, and each agent specializes in certain tasks. You can customize the agents to your liking, leading to very different playing styles. You have to make each decision carefully, as any wrong decision could cost an agent’s life.

Price: $4.99

Download

8. Fallout Shelter

The Fallout series has been a classic RPG and strategy series for over 20 years. With Fallout Shelter, a different take on the universe of Fallout comes to iPhone and iPad.

Anyone familiar with Fallout’s story will know that Vaults are important bunkers that form a crucial part of Fallout. A few chosen people are allowed to live in Vaults in case of an apocalyptic scenario. They are chosen based on how much they could help in rebuilding society after a catastrophic event.

In Fallout Shelter, the game’s objective is to manage every aspect of a Vault. In Fallout’s post-apocalyptic scenario, you have to ensure that each Vault resident is safe and well looked after.

While you take care of the residents, you also have to ensure that the Vault is safe from intruders and other such threats. To manage resources, you also have to send out a few residents to loot for both consumables and weapons.

While this game seems to cater to fans, if you’re a newcomer to this series, it is equal parts challenging and rewarding. The gameplay will keep you interested, and its events will tickle your brain cells.

Price: Free (In app-purchase starts from $0.99)

Download

9. Plants vs. Zombies

Plants vs. Zombies has been a classic game for mobile devices for quite some time now. Even after 13 years since the first release of the game, it continues to remain relevant worldwide.

The gameplay is relatively simple. You will have to grow plants outside your in-game home to save yourself from the zombies trying to eat you. The plants come in different varieties and with different weapons that can be used to destroy the zombies.

You will have to manage your resources and plant your different weapons in strategic places to deal with the horde of zombies. The zombies also come in specific types that can counter your plant-based weapons. You will have to think on your feet and act fast to keep them at a safe distance.

Price: Free (In app-purchase starts from $0.99)

Download

Wrapping up 

These are some of our favorite strategy games for iPhone and iPad. They will keep you occupied with interesting stories and tricky gameplay systems. Do you think we missed out on a game that you love? Or is there an underrated gem you want us to discover? Share them in the comments below!

title.rendered: How to use mental health features on iPhone

content.rendered:
Whether it’s the ability to track medication intake or sleep patterns, health-related features have been a vital part of every major iOS update since the introduction of the Apple Watch and Health app. With iOS 17 or later, iPhone users can track their mental health in the Health app.

If you’re someone who likes to keep track of every aspect of your mind and body, it’s natural to be excited about this new mental health feature in the Health app. So, here’s everything that you need to know about Mental Wellbeing and how you can use it to log your mood or emotions on your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • What is Apple's Mental Wellbeing feature?
  • How to log your mood or emotion in the Health app on your iPhone
  • How to take a depression or anxiety assessment in the Health app
  • How to view your mental health data on iPhone

What is Apple’s Mental Wellbeing feature?

Mental Wellbeing in the Health app allows you to efficiently track your mental health-related metrics. You can use this feature to assess your risk of experiencing symptoms related to anxiety or depression and log how you’re feeling each day to see how your mood changes over time. You can also discover how various factors like exercise, sleeping patterns, and time in daylight affect your mood.

Apple has also integrated the ability to log your emotions and daily moods into watchOS with a dedicated Mindfulness app. With this app, you can turn the Digital Crown to scroll through shapes and log how you’re feeling.

Even though this feature is not intended to replace the advice of a medical professional, it still offers a great way to take care of your mental health. It is user-friendly and enables you to monitor your mood and recognize mood patterns to observe changes over time. Moreover, If you’re feeling down, you can conveniently find mental health resources in the Health app.

As you’ve read earlier, this mental wellbeing metric, ‘State of Mind,’ allows you to log your mood or overall emotional state into the health app. Here’s how to use this feature on your iPhone or other Apple devices.

How to log your mood or emotion in the Health app on your iPhone

  1. Open the Health app on your iPhone → Navigate to the Browse tab.
  2. Go to Mental Wellbeing → State of Mind → Get Started.
    After the initial setup, Get Started will be replaced by a Log button.


    ‍ 
  3. Select if you want to log your emotion or mood → Tap Next.
  4. Use the slider to log how you’re feeling → Tap Next.
  5. Select words that best describe what you’re feeling → Tap Next.
  6. Select what’s making you feel these emotions → Tap Done.


    ‍ 
  7. Tap Turn on Reminders to receive reminders twice a day.
  8. Or tap Edit Schedule → Add Reminder to select a different time.

How to take a depression or anxiety assessment in the Health app

In addition to tracking your mood or emotional state, the Health app also offers the ability to let you conduct quick assessments to evaluate your risk of experiencing symptoms related to anxiety and depression on a scale of six. Here’s how to take these assessments and share the results if required.

  1. Open the Health app → Navigate to the Browse tab → Tap Mental Wellbeing.
  2. Select Depression Risk or Anxiety Risk.
  3. Tap Take Questionnaire → Begin.


    ‍ 
  4. Answer the questions honestly → Tap Done.
  5. Tap Export PDF to save the result on your iPhone or share it.
  6. Tap Done after you complete the whole procedure.

How to view your mental health data on iPhone

Once you regularly start logging your mental health-related metrics in the Health app, you can access various insights derived from the data to help you understand what factors have an influence over your overall mental health. Here’s how you can access these helpful insights on your iPhone:

  1. Open the Health app → navigate to the Browse tab.
  2. Tap Mental Wellbeing. You will find all the logged insights on the page for Mental Wellbeing.
  3. Tap the card for State of Mind → Show in Charts to find details about your mood and emotional health.


    ‍ 
  4. Go back and tap the other cards related to Depression Risk, Mindful Minutes, or any other metrics to discover useful details about them.

Pro tip: If needed, you can pin these metrics to the Summary tab. Just scroll down to the end of the page and tap Add to Pinned.

Wrapping up…

All in all, the Mental Wellbeing feature in the Health app can be a very useful tool for individuals who seek to improve their mental health. And thanks to this in-depth guide, you should be able to use this feature on your iPhone with ease. However, if you have any queries or concerns, please feel free to drop them in the comments section below.

  • How to use your iPhone to lead a healthy lifestyle

title.rendered: How to Use Shared With You on iPhone and iPad

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Shared with You collects iMessage content into apps like Safari, Photos, and Music so you can revisit shared items without digging through texts.
  • It works automatically in iOS 15 and later—shared links, songs, and images show up in their respective apps with sender labels.
  • You can turn it off per app or contact via Settings > Messages > Shared with You for more control over what gets shown.
  • Delete individual shared items in Safari or Messages to tidy up without disabling the entire feature.
  • To disable Shared with You entirely, go to Settings > Messages and toggle off the feature under Shared with You.

Thanks to dozens of instant messaging apps, sharing contacts, links, music, etc., has become easier. But, when the time finally comes to open the item shared with you, everything seems lost. Either the link would’ve gone up in the chat, or you’d be too lazy to search for it. Fortunately, there is a dedicated section where all the shared items are stored! Enters the Shared with You feature on your iPhone. In this article, we will learn about what is Apple’s “Shared with You” feature on your iPhone and how you can access this section and use it to improve your experience.

Table of Contents
  • What is Shared with You?
  • How to Use Shared With You on iPhone
  • How to Turn Off Shared With You on iPhone
    • 1. Disable "Shared With You" for a Specific App
    • 2. Turn Off “Shared With You” for Specific Contacts
    • 3. Disable "Shared With You" Completely
  • How to Remove ‘Shared With You’ Links in Safari on iPhone
  • How to Remove ‘Shared With You’ Links in Messages on iPhone

What is Shared with You?

Apple provided a Shared with You feature in the Messages app with iOS 15. It segregates the content that people send into different sections. For example, all the websites shared with you are in the Links section, images in the Photos section, etc.

And it doesn’t stop here—Shared with You also adds the items shared to the proper apps. This means that if someone shares a link on Messages, it will be not only in the Messages’ Links section but also in Safari.

Similarly, if someone shares a photo, it will appear in Messages as a separate section and also in the Photos app.

How to Use Shared With You on iPhone

Shared with You is enabled by default on your iPhone, so it doesn’t require any setup or toggling to work. However, it is only compatible with the media shared in iMessage.

There are several Shared with You integrations across the iOS apps, some of which are mentioned below:

  • Photos: When someone sends you an image via iMessage, it will automatically show up in the For You tab of the Photos app. You can save it to your Photo library directly from this section.

    Moreover, if you tap the name label at the bottom, the image in iMessage with the in-reply thread open will appear.
  • Apple News: If anyone sends you an Apple News story via iMessage, it automatically appears in the Today and Following tabs.
  • Safari: Many times, friends share links to articles and news pieces that may be useful to us. Now, you’ll no longer need to search your iMessage chat and find the link. Instead, all the links shared with you will show in a separate section in Safari.
  • Apple Music and Podcast: Music and podcast links shared via iMessage show up in the Shared with You section in the Listen Now tab in the Apple Music and Podcast app.
  • Apple TV: When someone sends a movie or a TV show link via iMessage, the TV show or the movie will appear in the Shared with You section of the Watch Now tab so you can start watching it quickly.

Besides, you can access the Shared with You section in Books, Files, Notes, and Reminders among native iOS apps.

Apart from Shared with You, you can use SharePlay to watch movies and TV shows together on your iPhone. To learn more, check out our detailed guide on how to use SharePlay.

How to Turn Off Shared With You on iPhone

While “Shared with You” integration in other apps is great, there may come a point when you start finding it more annoying than useful. Keeping that in mind, Apple gives you complete control over the feature; you can either disable it altogether or turn it off for a specific app.

1. Disable “Shared With You” for a Specific App

While the “Shared with You” functionality may annoy you when using certain apps, you may actually find it useful in some. If so, you can turn off the “Shared with You” functionality for specific apps instead of turning it off altogether.

  1. In the Messages settings, tap on Shared with You.
  2. Here, turn off the toggle next to Apps in which you want to disable the Shared with You functionality.

Alternatively, if you just want to prevent a specific conversation from appearing in Shared with You, you can simply hide it.

2. Turn Off “Shared With You” for Specific Contacts

Looking for a way to turn off ‘Shared with You’ for specific contacts or iMessage group chats? Well, you can do that too from the Messages app. Here are the steps explaining how to do it:

  1. Locate and open the Messages app on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Open a Messages thread → Then, tap the name at the top.
  3. Toggle off Show in Shared with You → Then tap Done.

3. Disable “Shared With You” Completely

Besides Safari, many other native and third-party apps on your iPhone and iPad also support ‘Shared with You.’ If you want to turn the feature off only for specific apps, follow these steps:

  1. Open the Settings app, scroll down and tap on Apps.
  2. Here, locate and tap on Messages settings.
  3. Next, tap the Shared with You tab and toggle off Automatic Sharing on the subsequent menu.

How to Remove ‘Shared With You’ Links in Safari on iPhone

What if you want to get rid of links that you don’t like but keep using the feature? In that case, you can easily delete certain unwanted links in Safari instead of turning off ‘Shared with You’ entirely.

  1. Locate and open Safari on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Tap the tab view icon → Then, tap the Plus icon.
    This will open the Safari start page on your device.
  3. Tap and hold a shared link that you wish to delete.
  4. Finally, tap on Remove Link to delete the shared link.

How to Remove ‘Shared With You’ Links in Messages on iPhone

If you, for some reason, aren’t able to delete ‘Shared with You’ links from the Safari start page, you can delete them from the Messages app on your iPhone. This essentially does the same thing from the Messages app instead of Safari. Here are the steps explaining how to do it:

  1. Locate and open the Messages app on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Open a Messages thread → Then, tap the name at the top.
  3. Now, tap and hold a shared link that you wish to delete.
  4. Finally, tap Delete to remove the link shared with you.

Shared with You is an excellent feature on iPhone and iPad. It lowers the number of steps required to search for a shared item. However, it is limited by the iMessage-only functionality. Had Apple opened up its API to third-party developers, it would have been one of the best iOS features.

What are your thoughts about Shared with You? Share in the comments below!

  • How to use Notification Summary on iPhone

keyPoints.title: Shared with You Overview
keyPoints.explanation: This feature, introduced with iOS 15, organizes shared content like links and photos into dedicated sections across various apps, making it easier to access shared items.

keyPoints.title: Using Shared with You Effectively
keyPoints.explanation: Shared with You works automatically with iMessage to transfer shared content such as photos, links, and media to relevant app sections, enhancing your sharing experience.

keyPoints.title: Disabling Shared with You per App or Contact
keyPoints.explanation: You can turn off Shared with You for specific apps or contacts through Settings and Messages, giving you control over what data appears in your apps.

keyPoints.title: Removing Unwanted Shared Links
keyPoints.explanation: Unwanted links can be deleted in Safari or Messages to keep your Shared with You sections clean without disabling the feature entirely.

keyPoints.title: Turning Off Shared with You Completely
keyPoints.explanation: If you prefer to disable the feature across all apps, you can do so via Settings under Messages, stopping any automatic sharing through Shared with You.

Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: Best VR Games for iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
Virtual reality games are unbelievably addictive. With immersive 3D experience and spectacular graphics, they take you into a make-believe world where everything looks exceptional. Though I am not a hardcore gamer, I love to indulge in beautiful games with a great concept. Having played many exciting games, I thought of taking my love for gaming to an altogether new level. Based on the thrill and unmatched concept, these VR Games for iPhone have become my hot favorite.

Table of Contents
  • 1. InCell VR
  • 2. VR XRacer
  • 3. Fractal Combat X (FCX)
  • 4. Final Kick VR

1. InCell VR

Enjoy playing action/racing games? InCell VR can be a typical potboiler for you as it’s got everything you would want to infuse plenty of fun into your gaming! You have to give your best to prevent the world from being eliminated. Enter the micro world, explore the human cell and bring all your experience and excellence to fight out the challenge of virus wave.

Though the game is designed for VR, you can play it even without a headset. Moreover, InCell is compatible with View-Master, Fibrum, Homido, Lakento, Archos, Durovis and much other Cardboard like headsets.

Price: Free
Download

2. VR XRacer

Get ready for some fast-paced action as VR XRacer is fully readied to ramp up your adrenaline! You have to lead your team to safeguard the earth from the UFO spaceship attacks. Make the best use of destructive missiles and lethal weapons to destroy the enemies.

As the airway is extremely dangerous, you need to on the money at all times to not just avoid getting killed but also fight out the powerful enemies. There are two modes: virtual reality and hand modes. Awesome 3D visual effects and graphics ensure you never get tired of playing.

Price: Free
Download

3. Fractal Combat X (FCX)

Are you up for a scintillating fight combat game? Fractal Combat X can be an absolute entertainer for you! Enriched by the awe-inspiring 3D graphics, incredible fractal landscapes, this VR game is pure class. There are tons of missions in the story mode to keep you hooked for long.

The fascinating soundtrack brings the real spice into the play. As new missions are added regularly, you always have something really cool to go for!

Price: Free
Download

4. Final Kick VR

Do you really love the tense moments of penalty shots? “Final Kick VR” has to be your top-notch choice as a big football fan.

Play against the best teams in the world. Perfect your defining shots and crush your opponents with your excellent skill and then become the world champion. This VR game will provide you an excellent experience of your football fantasy.

Price: Free
Download

That’s all for now!

What’s your favorite?

Enjoyed taking a peek at these games? I hope you have already grabbed some of them for your fun time, haven’t you? Do let us know your picks?

  • Tower Defense Games for iPhone and iPad
  • Best Card Games for iPhone and iPad

title.rendered: Best Bluetooth FM Transmitters for iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
If you are an iPhone user, you might be familiar with online radio. You can find plenty of online radio apps in the App Store, and some are paid, and some are free. However, many iPhone users opt for FM transmitters. Whenever you feel like listening to music in the absence of the Internet, FM transmitters come in handy, especially while traveling. When you plan to travel, instead of spending money on Internet data plans or Wi-Fi, you can use FM transmitters. It is an excellent way to listen to your playlists directly from your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • 1. LIHAN
  • 2. Nulaxy KM18
  • 3. Criacr
  • 4. GOgroove FlexSMART X3
  • 5. IMDEN

1. LIHAN

Blessed with appreciable sound quality, LIHAN is good enough to spice up your music time. The built-in microphone comes with noise suppression technology to keep background clamor away during your phone calls.

Two USB ports, it ensures you are able to charge multiple devices simultaneously. Another notable feature is the desired security it offers while powering your device. Being pretty compact, it’s easy to carry.

USP: Top-quality microphone
Check out on Amazon

2. Nulaxy KM18

Nulaxy KM18 excels as a car FM transmitter, Bluetooth receiver or car audio adapter. It quickly detects the battery voltage level and displays in on the 1.44 inches LCD. Thus, you remain posted about the battery voltage. 5V-2.1A charging port lets you safely charge your device.

Advanced interference and noise cancellation technology boost your calling experience by providing clear sound. One of the most notable qualities of KM18 is the broad compatibility. For instance, it works with the iOS device, MP3, and MP4 players, etc. Besides, KM18 is available in six color options like black, coffee, golden, green, etc.

USP: Crystal clear sound
Check out on Amazon

3. Criacr

Criacr ticks off most boxes to be your reliable FM transmitter. It offers FM radio frequency range from 87.5 to 108.0MHz. As a result, you have a more stable frequency.

The High-Fi stereo sound enriches your music. It supports multiple formats like MP3/wma/wav/flac to ensure you relish great music experience without any hiccups. Plus, the inclusion of two USB ports helps you keep your devices powered up with ease.

USP: High-Fi stereo sound
Check out on Amazon

4. GOgroove FlexSMART X3

The biggest highlight of GOgroove FlexSMART X3 is the multipoint Bluetooth connectivity. Hence, you can connect it to two devices at once to let you stream music and take calls from both the devices.

The mic is endowed with high-quality noise reduction technology. That means your calling won’t be interrupted by the clamor. With regard to charging your device, you can expect it to live up to the task effectively. Lastly, FlexSMART X3 is supported by the three-year warranty.

USP: Multipoint Bluetooth connectivity
Check out on Amazon

5. IMDEN

IMDEN Bluetooth FM transmitter has two USB ports charger support; you can charge your iPhone and iPad simultaneously while you are on a long drive. The transmitter delivers excellent performance with noise suppression (CVC) technology and gives you crystal clear call.

The multi-functional device enables you to answer, redial, dismiss or end a call with a click of a button. You can drive safely as this transmitter supports voice navigation of your iPhone. IMDEN has packed safety features to protect your device against over-current, over-voltage and short-circuit.

USP: High-performance microphone
Check out on Amazon

That’s all, folks!

Your pick?

I’m sure you have succeeded in picking out a fine FM transmitter for your iOS device. Would you like to tell us something about it?

Don’t miss:

  • How to label Bluetooth devices on iPhone

@graph.name: LIHAN Wireless Bluetooth 5.3 FM Transmitter
@graph.description: The built-in microphone comes with noise suppression technology to keep background clamor away during your phone calls. Two USB ports, it ensures you are able to charge multiple devices simultaneously. Another notable feature is the desired security it offers while powering your device.

@graph.name: Nulaxy Car Bluetooth FM Transmitter
@graph.description: Nulaxy KM18 excels as a car FM transmitter, Bluetooth receiver or car audio adapter. It quickly detects the battery voltage level and displays in on the 1.44 inches LCD. Advanced interference and noise cancellation technology boost your calling experience by providing clear sound. One of the most notable qualities of KM18 is the broad compatibility.

@graph.name: Criacr FM Radio Transmitter Receiver
@graph.description: Criacr ticks off most boxes to be your reliable FM transmitter. It offers FM radio frequency range from 87.5 to 108.0MHz. As a result, you have a more stable frequency. The High-Fi stereo sound enriches your music. It supports multiple formats like MP3/wma/wav/flac to ensure you relish great music experience without any hiccups.

@graph.name: GOgroove FlexSMART X3 FM Radio Transmitter
@graph.description: The biggest highlight of GOgroove FlexSMART X3 is the multipoint Bluetooth connectivity. Hence, you can connect it to two devices at once to let you stream music and take calls from both the devices. The mic is endowed with high-quality noise reduction technology.

@graph.name: IMDEN Bluetooth 5.3 FM Transmitter
@graph.description: IMDEN Bluetooth FM transmitter has two USB ports charger support; you can charge your iPhone and iPad simultaneously while you are on a long drive. The transmitter delivers excellent performance with noise suppression (CVC) technology and gives you crystal clear call. The multi-functional device enables you to answer, redial, dismiss or end a call with a click of a button. You can drive safely as this transmitter supports voice navigation of your iPhone.

title.rendered: Top iPad mini 6 Accessories to Improve Your Experience

content.rendered:
The iPad mini 6 is one of my favorite devices, but a few extras can make it even better. Yes, I’m talking about the best iPad mini 6 accessories that can help you get more out of this power-packed tablet. From protection to enhanced functionality, the list below covers it all and applies to all kinds of different use cases.

1. ESR folio case: All-round protection

There are many great cases for iPad mini 6, but my favorite is this one from ESR that’s got a slim polycarbonate back with a sleek folio cover. It offers all-around protection to keep away scratches and minor bumps. 

Moreover, there’s a magnetic clasp that wraps around your Apple Pencil to secure it while charging and keep the case securely closed to protect your screen. You can also prop up your iPad mini in three different viewing angles for watching something or working with your stylus. 

Pros

  • All-round protection
  • Includes a kickstand
  • Holds the Apple Pencil
  • Affordable price
  • Four color options

Cons

  • The clasp feels a bit clunky

Check out on Amazon

2. Ailun screen protector: Keep scratches away

There’s nothing as traumatic as damaging your device’s display. Why take the risk when screen protection is so affordable and readily available? Check out this hard, tempered glass screen protector that’s just what your iPad mini needs. 

It maintains the original touch screen sensitivity and has an oleophobic coating to keep away fingerprint smudges. Moreover, it’s easy to install and remove. The curved edges fit perfectly around your iPad mini without adding any weight. What’s more? It comes with a 12-month warranty. 

Pros

  • Easy to install and remove
  • Oleophobic coating
  • Inexpensive
  • 12-month warranty

Cons

  • None

Check out on Amazon

3. MoKo sleeve: Carry in style

If you’re always on the go, it’s a good idea to get a sleeve for additional protection. I love this one from MoKo made of premium polyester and a high-density fluff lining that keeps away scratches, dust, splashes, and other dangers.

Moreover, it can provide shock absorption when your tablet is in your bag or if it accidentally falls. There’s also a smooth and durable zipper to prevent your device from accidentally falling out. The best part is that it’s lightweight, stylish, and available in eight colors. 

Pros

  • Stylish
  • Soft and cushioned
  • 8 color options
  • High-quality zipper

Cons

  • None

Check out on Amazon

4. Logitech wireless keyboard: Use your iPad mini like a computer

Although the iPad mini is a bit small to truly use as a laptop, you can still use a keyboard with it for easier typing. Apart from keyboard cases, I love this Logitech keyboard with an integrated cradle to hold your tablet at the right angle to read while you type.

The great thing is that it works across your tablet, phone, or computer. So, it’s compatible with Windows, Mac, iPadOS, iOS, and Android. At the same time, it’s also small and portable while still being comfortable enough to type on. This makes it one of the best iPad mini 6 accessories for students and professionals.

Pros

  • Ergonomic design for comfortable typing
  • Cost-effective
  • Cross-platform compatibility

Cons

  • Feels a bit heavy

Check out on Amazon

5. Twelve South HoverBar Duo: Multifunctional stand

I love the iPad mini for its portability, but sometimes you need it to sit still so you can watch something, record a video, or hop onto or video call. Hence begins the hunt for the perfect stand, and the Twelve South HoverBar Duo is the best one I’ve tried.  

It includes a weighted desktop stand and shelf clamp for maximum flexibility and value. Plus, it’s fully adjustable, and you can place your iPad in almost any angle you desire. This is perfect for content creators.

Moreover, it can hold any other phone or tablet too. It’s the perfect stand to use with the Center Stage feature on your iPad mini.

For more details, check out my full review of the Twelve South HoverBar Duo.  

Pros

  • Multiple angles
  • Robust build quality
  • Ideal for watching and recording videos, plus making calls
  • Compatible with any phone or tablet

Cons

  • Shelf clamp may not fit on thicker tables or shelves.

Check out on Amazon

6. Apple Pencil 2: Must-have for writers & artists

If you love writing or sketching, the Apple Pencil 2 is a life-changing little gadget. It expands your creative possibilities by allowing you to quickly digitize your words or creations to take them to the next level.

Although there are other stylus, the Apple Pencil boasts pixel-perfect precision, plus tilt and pressure sensitivity. Moreover, it magnetically attaches to iPad mini, charges wirelessly, and lets you change tools with a simple double-tap. Pretty nifty! 

Pros

  • Super smooth performance without lag
  • Tilt and pressure sensitivity for detailing
  • Magnetic attachment and charging

Cons

  • Pricey

Check out on Amazon

7. Hiearcool USB-C dongle: Must-have for connectivity

The iPad mini 6 comes with a USB-C port, and you can expand its capabilities with this dongle. It perfectly combines all the functions you need, such as an HDMI port, two USB 3.0 ports, SD/TF Card Adapter, and a Type-C Power Delivery charging port.

You can enjoy lifelike 4K 3840 x 2160 30Hz HDMI images that bring an immersive 3D resolution experience. Further, the dongle is super lightweight and portable for everyday convenience. Of course, you can also use it with your MacBook.

Pros

  • Compact size
  • All the ports you need
  • Supports 4K
  • Multifunctional

Cons

  • Build quality could be better

Check out on Amazon

8. Cellet car mount: Convenient for your commute

Want to prop up your iPad mini in your car to see Maps while you drive? It’s easy-peasy with this handy stand. It provides a stable viewing platform with an adjustable base that perfectly fits vehicle cup holders from 2. 86 inches to 3. 47 inches.

The arm can be extended up to 13.5 inches, and the protective soft holder will not scratch your device. It’s also got a 360-degree rotational ability to adjust the viewing angle as required.

Pros

  • Sturdy
  • Easy to install
  • Adjustable viewing angles
  • Firm grip on your tablet

Cons

  • Takes up the cup holder space, so you can’t use it.

Check out on Amazon

9. Anker USB-C power bank: Charge on-the-go

The iPad mini 6 battery life differs according to what you’re using it for. If you want to continue using it without interruptions, it’s wise to get a power bank. That’s why you need this PowerCore external battery with an 18W Power Delivery USB-C port and a PowerIQ-enabled USB-A port. You can use the dual USB ports to charge another device at the same time as your iPad.

Further, it’s got a sleek matte exterior and cool-blue LED light-wheel to display battery level. It’s a premium product, both inside and out. You also get a worry-free 18-month warranty and friendly customer service.

Pros

  • High capacity
  • Slim and lightweight
  • Affordable price
  • 18-month warranty

Cons

  • Takes all day to charge before use

Check out on Amazon

That’s my list of the top ten best iPad mini 6 accessories you need to make the most of your tablet. Let me know in the comments below what else you’d like to know.

  • Best iPad mini 6 screen protectors
  • Best keyboard cases for iPad mini 6
  • Download the iPad mini 6 and 7 wallpapers in 4K

title.rendered: Best CRM Apps for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Customer relationship management is a pragmatic practice that drives future growth. It is done through comprehensive planning and the right approach. Throughout the long and engaging process of managing your customers, you must be prepared to make the most of every opportunity coming your way. Though there are various ways to maintain a healthy rapport with customers, well-designed apps can bring amazing convenience. We have lined up the best CRM Apps for iPhone so that you can choose the most efficient app to boost your productivity.

1. Zendesk Sell

Base CRM Apps for iPhone and Sales Tracking app enable you to manage contacts, track sales and create tasks with great comfort. You can quickly sync the changes with the cloud to keep them fully secured.

It helps you capture info efficiently during or after meeting without having to take long steps.

You can add tasks and reminders so that you are always on task and never get late. With the use of Geo-location, it lets you visualize your customer on a map. Besides, you can log calls with clients, view the latest updates from your colleagues, and more.

Price: Free

Download

2. Contacts Journal CRM

Contacts Journal CRM has been designed to solve your customer relationship management activities immaculately. You can create private contacts and private groups to keep information separate and not allow them to mix up with your personal ones. Also you can call, SMS or even email your contacts right from the App.

You can easily attach documents to contacts via Wi-Fi. To bring some personal touch into play, you can also create custom fields and attach custom data to each contact. To remain informed about the upcoming assignments, you can add alerts to Notification Center.

With the use of Dropbox, you can transfer data between iPhone and iPad. It works even offline.

Price: Free

Download

3. Zoho CRM

Zoho CRM makes it very convenient for you to manage, edit, view, and create and delete contacts. It has a very significant search function to help you find out all the necessary info about your customers easily.

You can add or modify customer info even offline. It provides you the ability to call your clients directly from the app.

Price: Free

Download

4. Nimble

Nimble helps you in building an excellent rapport with your customers in some clever ways. It allows you to gather all the necessary info such as contact details, insights, email, and more at one place so that you can easily retrieve them.

This app is equipped to deliver insights about your contacts, mutual interest, shared passions and lots of other important things thanks largely to its ability to search the web and social networks.

Price: Free

Download

5. Salesmate – Sales CRM

Here’s an all-in-one CRM app that makes it a breeze to manage your sales process and pipeline from the comfort of your iPhone or iPad. It primarily helps you gain control of your sales results by focusing on all the right contacts to stimulate business growth.

Further, it boasts many useful features like two-way email sync, locating your nearby contacts, comprehensive information about your prospects, and more. It’s been designed as a companion to the Salesmate CRM web app and supports integration with over 600+ third-party apps, including Google Apps.

Price: Free

Download

6. Microsoft Dynamics CRM

Microsoft Dynamics CRM has been designed to help you remain updated with your customer info in the easiest possible way. It allows you to get prepared in advance for every appointment. With the use of it, you can update your notes, tasks, contacts, accounts, and leads conveniently.

You can quickly enter customer data with just a few steps, track progress, access your accounts, contacts, and more from the dashboard easily.

Price: Free

Download

7. Insightly CRM

Insightly CRM has been smartly designed to carry out the assigned task with precision. This app lets you call, email, text message, and map your shared contacts. You can manage contacts, projects, and view email shared by others in a team with ease.

You can sign up for a free amount of up to 3 users.

Price: Free

Download

8. OnePageCRM

OnePageCRM is an easy to use tool to convert sales to a simple to-do list. The simple UI enables salespeople to manage their contacts, sales, to-do lists, log calls, and create new tasks. You can also integrate the OnePageCRM with MailChimp, Unbounce, Wufoo, Skype, Evernote, Google Apps, Help Scout, and Zapier to make the most out of it.

It is a professional app with great productivity features that actually helps. The app is free to download and use. However, you will need to have a OnePageCRM account, to begin with.

Price: Free

Download

9. Capsule CRM

Capsule CRM is very simple to use. This app allows you to start calls or email directly from a contact’s profile. You can view a contact’s location on the map; see the history of emails and notes about a contact.

It lets you keep track of sales opportunities. Moreover, you can create and assign follow-up tasks depending on requirements.

Price: Free

Download

That’s all!

What’s your pick?

So, which one have you handpicked to bolster your productivity? Is it the lightweight CRM Apps for iPhone or the one that’s fully-featured? Let us know its name.

You might want to refer these posts as well:

  • Best Project Manager Apps
  • Zoho Assist for Mac

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Best iPhone 13 & 13 Pro Cases You Can Buy

content.rendered:
Apple’s iPhone 13 lineup is all about the powerful new A15 Bionic chip, a redesigned camera setup, and gorgeous new colors. The base model of iPhone 13 and the higher-end 13 Pro are of a similar 6.1-inch size, so I’ve put together a list of the best cases for iPhone 13 and 13 Pro that you should check out.

After all, if you’re lucky enough to get your hands on these devices, you’ll want to keep them safe. Take your pick from the cases below and ward off the scratches, scuffs, bumps, and dust!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Spigen ultra hybrid: Budget friendly iPhone 13 case
  • 2. Casely: Cute and artistic design
  • 3. Temdan: Best iPhone 13 waterproof case
  • 4. totallee: Best iPhone 13 clear case
  • 5. Ringke Air-S: Minimalist and stylish
  • 6. CASEKOO: Best iPhone 13 slim case
  • 7. TORRAS Moon Climber: Best kickstand case

1. Spigen ultra hybrid: Budget friendly iPhone 13 case

Safety meets simplicity in this hybrid clear case for iPhone 13/13 Pro from one of my favorite brands. Spigen has crafted this case from a sturdy blend of TPU and polycarbonate to offer robust protection. There is no need to worry about scratches and shocks while you go about life’s adventures.

Moreover, the transparent design means you can show off your beautiful phone without compromising on protection. The buttons and cutouts are designed for precise usage, and the raised bezels keep the screen and camera safely lifted off flat surfaces.

You can also get color options around the edges to match your iPhone.

Pros

  • Hybrid protection
  • Slim and lightweight
  • Color options
  • Affordable

Cons

  • Attracts finger smudges

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 13 | iPhone 13 Pro

2. Casely: Cute and artistic design

Want a unique and fun look for your iPhone 13 or 13 Pro? You’ve got to check out Casely. It features an impressive variety of artistic cases that are bound to appeal to every taste. 

From cute prints to minimalist abstract patterns and everything in between, you’ll be spoilt for choice when picking a look for your phone.

Casely offers three types of cases that it calls Classic, Classic+MagSafe, and Bold+MagSafe. Of these, the Bold series is the most protective, with 8-foot military-grade drop protection, a slip-resistant side grip, raised lips, and shock-absorbing pockets to keep your iPhone intact.

You also get a 1-year warranty on all cases, so you can rest assured about your purchase.

Moreover, Casely is environmentally responsible and uses recycled and non-toxic materials in its manufacturing and packaging. It also donates to charities and environmental projects, so you know your money is going to a worthy place.

Check out on GetCasely: iPhone 13 | iPhone 13 Pro

3. Temdan: Best iPhone 13 waterproof case

With the incredible camera on your iPhone 13/13 Pro, you’ll want to take it along on your underwater adventures to grab some epic shots. That’s why you need waterproof case for iPhone 13 or 13 Pro.

It offers IP68 certified waterproofing up to 6.6ft/2m underwater for up to 30 minutes. The snug fit and built-in screen protector offer a reliable seal while maintaining responsiveness. At the same time, it can also withstand drops from 6.6’/2 m, making it perfect for all kinds of adventures!

Pros

  • IP68-certified Waterproof
  • Military-grade drop proof
  • Maintains responsiveness
  • Does not impair call quality
  • Good grip

Cons

  • The screen protector attracts fingerprints easily

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 13 | iPhone 13 Pro

4. totallee: Best iPhone 13 clear case

Here’s an elegant, slim and clear case that’s perfect for flaunting your iPhone 13 or 13 Pro while protecting it. It has a rubbery finish that adds extra grip and reduces the chances of your device slipping out of your hands.

Moreoever, it doesn’t turn yellow over time thanks to the high-quality, durable TPU material. This also absorbs shocks and provides impact protection. Each case is backed by a 30-day money-back guarantee, so you can buy with confidence. Apart from the transparent one, totallee also offers four color options.

Pros

  • Slim and sleek
  • Good grip
  • Shows off your iPhone’s design
  • Does not yellow over time
  • 30-day money back guarantee

Cons

  • The TPU attracts fingerprint smudges easily

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 13 | iPhone 13 Pro

5. Ringke Air-S: Minimalist and stylish

For those who prefer a minimalist look, this iPhone 13/13 Pro slim case ticks all the boxes. The soft, flexible design matches your device’s thin profile. Further, the soft TPU layer prevents scratches from daily use, while raised bezels carefully lift the front display away from flat surfaces.

You can also attach a wrist or neck strap thanks to the built-in dual QuikCatch lanyard holes. Choose from three beautiful colors, namely black, pink, and blue.

Pros

  • Minimalist design
  • Ultra-slim
  • Attractive translucent finish
  • includes lanyard holes
  • 3 color options

Cons

  • It does not support adhesive accessories such as a ring holder, cardholder, etc
  • Not MagSafe compatible

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 13 | iPhone 13 Pro

6. CASEKOO: Best iPhone 13 slim case

Here’s an innovative translucent case by CASEKOO that retains your phone’s elegant look while adding military-grade protection. It’s ultra-thin yet ultra-protective. The shock-absorbing TPU bumper diffuses impact, safeguarding your phone from dreaded drops and bumps.

Further, the1.8 mm raised hard bezels around the camera, and the 1.5 mm raised edges around the screen keep the scratches away. It feels great to hold, and the super=precise cutouts enhance the user experience.

Pros

  • Ultra-slim ergonomic design
  • Military-grade protection
  • Raised edges for screen and camera protection
  • Stylish matte finish

Cons

  • No color options

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 13 | iPhone 13 Pro

7. TORRAS Moon Climber: Best kickstand case

Are you always video chatting or watching stuff on your phone? Then, this cool kickstand case is a must-have for you. It’s equipped with a sturdy, fully foldable, and adjustable metal kickstand that offers the perfect viewing angles to prevent back, neck, and wrist pain. Don’t tire out your hands and instead prop up your phone to view it hands-free.

Moreover, the four corners of the case are reinforced with airbags to offer military-grade protection against shocks and impact. It resists wear and tear to keep your phone looking immaculate. It’s also got a secure grip and supports wireless charging for convenience.

Pros

  • Has a foldable metal kickstand
  • Military-grade protection
  • Excellent grip
  • Does not yellow over time

Cons

  • None

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 13 | iPhone 13 Pro

That’s my roundup of the best iPhone 13 and 13 Pro cases that are worth checking out. They’re sure to protect your device while maintaining your style.

I’ll keep updating this list as I find and test new options. If you’ve got questions, let me know in the comments below, and I’ll be happy to help.

Read more:

  • Best iPhone 13 and iPhone 13 Pro screen protectors

title.rendered: Best MacBook Pro & Air Stands for Every Budget

content.rendered:
I overlooked the essence of computer stands for long before realizing it was all I needed for the muscle strains. And when I got one, the back pains vanished into thin air!

Here’s the thing: placing your computer below your eye level contributes to back pains, neck strains, and shoulder snap. And of course, all these reduce productivity. Using a stand raises your MacBook to your eye level, so you don’t have to bend the neck and strain the spine while working.

Plus, it relieves the pressure on the vent and prevents processor overheating. So, if you’re looking to increase your productivity, here are the best MacBook stands worth your cash! Let’s get started!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Soundance Laptop Stand – Detachable design
  • 2. Bestand laptop stand – Comes with a 1-year warranty
  • 3. Twelve South Bookarc Mod for MacBook – Most space-efficient
  • 4. Roost V3 laptop stand – Most lightweight
  • 5. Twelve South Curve – Sturdiest laptop stand
  • 6. Nulaxy laptop stand – Great colors
  • There you go with the best MacBook stands!

1. Soundance Laptop Stand – Detachable design

The Soundance laptop stand is sturdy, simple, and easy to set up. It features a thickened aluminum alloy and raises your computer by 6 inches to conveniently position your head.

Each holder on either side is 9.5 inches long and 10.2 inches apart. That separation distance is fair enough as most MacBooks are more than 11 inches wide.

Soundance’s stand also has a front braze to prevent sliding, and there’s a space to place your keyboard on the lower step. The top of each holder is rubberized to allow your computer to stick to the stand without falling. Additionally, there’s a rubber stage at each corner of the feet to help glue this to your tabletop.

Pros

  • Comfortable and easy to set up
  • The space between each arm and underneath allows proper ventilation
  • Rubberized components prevent slipping
  • Easy to install

Cons

  • Not ideal for taller people as the height isn’t adjustable
  • Disassembling requires efforts

Check out on Amazon

2. Bestand laptop stand – Comes with a 1-year warranty

With its rear braze and a 4mm thickness, the Bestand laptop stand has top-notch strength despite its simple appearance. It wields a 7000 series aluminum material, the sturdiest alloy of aluminum you can find. So, of course, you can trust this not to collapse, corrode, or wear out.

In addition to a fore anchor, the dotted silicone pad at each corner of the handle top sticks your laptop to the arm and prevents it from sliding off.

There are slits on the handle to ventilate your MacBook properly. However, this stand isn’t adjustable but is 9.44 inches wide towards the front end and raises your laptop by 5.51 inches.

Pros

  • Slit design allows excellent ventilation
  • Strong and durable material
  • 1-year warranty
  • Premium look
  • Rubber grip keeps it stable

Cons

  • Non-adjustable height
  • Older MacBooks may slide as the stand is a bit small to hold them

Check out on Amazon

3. Twelve South Bookarc Mod for MacBook – Most space-efficient

Do you often cast your MacBook to a larger monitor to use it in clamshell (close-display) mode? Twelve South has delved a little from the norm and added this folding Bookarc stand to its collection. It features an aluminum material and is compatible with 13 to 16-inch Macbooks.

The stand holds your Macbook vertically in closed-display mode when casting onto a wide, taller screen, saving space on your tabletop. In addition to space-saving, it also takes your Macbook off the table to keep it clean and evade accidental spills. And no worries, the holder fits Macbooks of various lengths so that yours won’t fall off.

Pros

  • Suitable if you own a tall monitor
  • Expands your workspace
  • Durable material
  • Keep your Macbook off the table to avoid liquid spills

Cons

  • Only supports Macbook’s closed display mode

Check out on: Amazon | Twelver South

4. Roost V3 laptop stand – Most lightweight

The Roost laptop stand has come a long way since version 1.0, but 3.0 (V3) has even better optimizations. It features thermoplastic elastomer rubber and polycarbonate material. Hence, it’s compact, sturdy, and unbelievably lightweight.

Ultimately, you can collapse this into a portable stick with a single flap and insert it into your bag without stress. There’s a pivot grip on either side of the stand to hold your laptop tightly. These also make it easy to close your PC without risking a fall.

It has many flexible hinges and is adjustable to seven different heights between 6 and 14 inches to bring your laptop to your eye level.

Pros

  • Portable, strong, and lightweight
  • Highly ergonomic
  • Easily extensible and foldable
  • Extended stand gives it stability

Cons

  • Lower height adjustment is limited to 6 inches
  • Expensive

Check out on: Amazon | Roost

5. Twelve South Curve – Sturdiest laptop stand

Here’s another simple laptop stand from Twelve South. This comes through in an aluminum alloy material and has a fixed height of 6 inches. The PC holders on either side are also distant apart. So this might not be suitable for smaller or mini laptops.

However, this is perfect for all MacBook models. An anti-slip silicone pad runs across the entire length of each PC sit to prevent it from sliding off or getting scratched. There’s also a curved braze in front to further guard your MacBook against sudden fall.

Pros

  • Simple and strong design
  • Silicone pads prevent your MacBook from sliding or scratches
  • Curved front anchor for protection fall
  • Available in two colors

Cons

  • Non-foldable
  • Non-ergonomic

Check out on: Amazon | Twelve South

6. Nulaxy laptop stand – Great colors

The Nulaxy laptop stand features a high-quality aluminum alloy plate and holds your PC on a silicone-padded seat. There are two sturdy legs with adjustable hinges capable of upholding a mass of 44lbs. These also raise your laptop as high as 10.6 inches.

It has three height adjustment options, and the seat is 10.2 inches wide. So it’s suitable for laptops with sizes ranging from 10 to 16 inches. The silicone pad at each corner of the PC seat increases the friction between your PC and the stand to prevent sliding off.

This one also comes in three different colors, so you have a couple of choices at your disposal. The hinges might also use some extra strength, but you should expect this since you want stability at any height.

Pros

  • Ergonomic
  • Comes in different colors
  • Elegant, sturdy, and stylish
  • 3 Height adjustment options
  • Has front anchors

Cons

  • Height adjustment might use some strength
  • Front anchors might hurt wrists after extended use

Check out on Amazon

There you go with the best MacBook stands!

Adding a solid stand to your MacBook makes it easier to use. Plus, it reduces stress, improves your posture, and increases productivity. Moreover, most of these stands support other laptops besides MacBook as well. I have kept the list balanced in terms of height adjustment.

Which one of these stands are you buying? Let me know in the comment section below.

  • Task Management Apps for Mac
  • MacBook Air M2 vs. MacBook Air M1: Worth the extra $200?

@graph.name: SOUNDANCE Laptop Stand
@graph.description: It features a thickened aluminum alloy and raises your computer by 6 inches to conveniently position your head. Each holder on either side is 9.5 inches long and 10.2 inches apart. That separation distance is fair enough as most MacBooks are more than 11 inches wide. Soundance’s stand also has a front braze to prevent sliding, and there’s a space to place your keyboard on the lower step. The top of each holder is rubberized to allow your computer to stick to the stand without falling.

@graph.name: Bestand Aluminum Cooling Laptop Stand
@graph.description: With its rear braze and a 4mm thickness, the Bestand laptop stand has top-notch strength despite its simple appearance. It wields a 7000 series aluminum material, the sturdiest alloy of aluminum you can find. In addition to a fore anchor, the dotted silicone pad at each corner of the handle top sticks your laptop to the arm and prevents it from sliding off.

@graph.name: Twelve South BookArc for MacBook
@graph.description: Twelve South has delved a little from the norm and added this folding Bookarc stand to its collection. It features an aluminum material and is compatible with 13 to 16-inch Macbooks. The stand holds your Macbook vertically in closed-display mode when casting onto a wide, taller screen, saving space on your tabletop.

@graph.name: Roost V3 Adjustable Laptop Stand
@graph.description: The Roost laptop stand has come a long way since version 1.0, but 3.0 (V3) has even better optimizations. It features thermoplastic elastomer rubber and polycarbonate material. Ultimately, you can collapse this into a portable stick with a single flap and insert it into your bag without stress. There’s a pivot grip on either side of the stand to hold your laptop tightly.

@graph.name: Twelve South Curve for MacBooks
@graph.description: This comes through in an aluminum alloy material and has a fixed height of 6 inches. The PC holders on either side are also distant apart. So this might not be suitable for smaller or mini laptops. An anti-slip silicone pad runs across the entire length of each PC sit to prevent it from sliding off or getting scratched. There’s also a curved braze in front to further guard your MacBook against sudden fall.

@graph.name: Nulaxy Fully Adjustable Laptop Stand
@graph.description: The Nulaxy laptop stand features a high-quality aluminum alloy plate and holds your PC on a silicone-padded seat. There are two sturdy legs with adjustable hinges capable of upholding a mass of 44lbs. These also raise your laptop as high as 10.6 inches. It has three height adjustment options, and the seat is 10.2 inches wide. So it’s suitable for laptops with sizes ranging from 10 to 16 inches.

title.rendered: What is call waiting on iPhone and how to activate it

content.rendered:
Did you miss an important call while you were taking on another? It can be quite frustrating when it happens. However, this is where the call waiting feature on your iPhone comes in! It notifies you about an incoming call when you’re on another call and lets you answer or decline it, so you never miss any important calls. Here’s everything you need to know about the call waiting feature on an iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • What is call waiting on iPhone?
  • How to turn on or off call waiting on iPhone
  • How does call waiting work on iPhone?
    • Switching between calls

What is call waiting on iPhone?

Call waiting is a convenient feature on your iPhone that lets you manage multiple calls simultaneously. If you’re on a call and there’s an incoming call, call waiting notifies you and gives you multiple options to handle the second call without disconnecting the first one.

This way, you can decide whether or not to take an incoming call without disrupting your ongoing conversation. It also provides flexibility to handle incoming calls without needing to hang up or let calls go unanswered. And most importantly, the feature works over practically all cellular and Wi-Fi calling arrangements.

How to turn on or off call waiting on iPhone

Activating or deactivating the call waiting feature on your iPhone is straightforward. Here’s what you need to do:

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone.
  2. Scroll down, select Apps and go to Phone.
  3. Tap on Call Waiting. If you use dual SIM, select between Primary and Secondary.
  4. Finally, toggle the switch next to Call Waiting on or off.

When call waiting is disabled, the second incoming call is automatically forwarded to voicemail without alerting you.

Note The call waiting functionality is controlled by your carrier. Some GSM network providers enable it by default, while others may require manual activation. If you use a CDMA network, additional assistance from your carrier may be necessary to set up call waiting on your iPhone.

How does call waiting work on iPhone?

When you have call waiting enabled on your iPhone, whenever you’re on a call and a second call comes in, your iPhone alerts you with a beep sound. In addition, the call screen displays details about the incoming caller, such as their name (if it’s saved in your contacts) or phone number, along with the following options to manage the second call:

  • Hold & Accept: It places your current call on hold and answers the incoming one. This allows you to accept the second call without disconnecting the first seamlessly.
  • End & Accept: Using it, you can disconnect the ongoing call and answer the new one. It’s a useful option when the second call is urgent and you no longer want to continue talking on the first one.
  • Decline: This sends the second call directly to your voicemail, allowing you to focus on your current conversation.

When you don’t take any action and the second call goes unanswered, it’s directed and sent to voicemail, granted you’ve enabled it on your iPhone. This ensures the caller can still leave a message for you to follow up later.

Switching between calls

If you choose the Hold & Accept option, you can alternate between the two calls or merge them as required using the following on-screen buttons:

  • Swap: Use it to switch between the active call and the one on hold. The caller on hold will not hear the ongoing conversation.
  • Merge: If your carrier supports it, you can merge both calls into a three-way conference call.

Note that this call waiting functionality works when you receive the second call on the same line. If you use dual SIM, you must enable Wi-Fi calling and have a data connection on your iPhone to leverage the feature.

Signing off…

You should be able to turn on call waiting on your iPhone easily with the provided steps. Whether it’s managing work-related conversations or catching up with loved ones, you can now handle multiple calls efficiently and never miss an important one again!

If you found this guide helpful, share it with your friends.

FAQs

Can I use call waiting while using Wi-Fi calling?

Yes, call waiting works with Wi-Fi calling, provided your carrier supports the feature. You’ll receive the same notifications for incoming calls.

Do iPhones show call waiting?

Yes, when call waiting is active, your iPhone shows the incoming call notification, along with multiple options to handle the second call.

Does call waiting cost money?

Call waiting is generally free, but some carriers may charge for the feature. Check with your network provider for details.

Also read:

  • How to record a phone call on iPhone
  • No sound during calls on iPhone? 12 Ways to fix it!
  • How to fix call failed on iPhone

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, call waiting works with Wi-Fi calling, provided your carrier supports the feature. You'll receive the same notifications for incoming calls.

title.rendered: How to install fonts on Mac: A complete guide

content.rendered:
macOS has plenty of built-in fonts, but you might want to install more to change the look of texts for your projects or designs. Fortunately, the Font Book app on Mac makes it easy to install both Apple and third-party fonts. Read on to learn how to install new fonts on a Mac, manage them, and troubleshoot fonts when they aren’t working.

Table of Contents
  • Where to find fonts for Mac?
  • How to install fonts on Mac
    • Install fonts using Font Book
    • Add fonts on a Mac manually
  • How to use installed fonts on Mac
  • How to manage your Mac fonts
  • What to do if the installed fonts don't show up on Mac?

Where to find fonts for Mac?

Aside from the fonts available for your Mac through Font Book, you can find more—mostly free—online. Here are some popular third-party platforms worth checking out:

  • DaFont
  • Google Fonts
  • Urbanfonts
  • Fontspace
Note macOS supports fonts in TrueType (.ttf), Variable TrueType (.ttf), TrueType Collection (.ttc), OpenType and OpenType-SVG (.otf), and OpenType Collection (.ttc) formats. According to Apple, legacy suitcase TrueType and PostScript Type 1 LWFN fonts may work, but they are not recommended.

How to install fonts on Mac

You can either install fonts on your Mac using the Font Book app or install them manually if you downloaded them from third-party sources. Let’s walk you through both methods below.

Install fonts using Font Book

The easiest way to get cool new fonts on your Mac is to install them via Font Book. Here are the steps you need to follow:

  1. Launch the Font Book app on your Mac.
  2. Switch to the Downloadable tab to browse available fonts. Or use the search box in the top-right corner to look for a specific font.
  3. Click the download icon (a downward arrow inside a circle) in the top-right corner of a font card to install it. You can also change the view of the downloadable fonts using the menu at the top of the Font Book window to preview each one before downloading.

Once you download the font, it will be available in your active user account across all apps that support it.

Add fonts on a Mac manually

Due to limited fonts on Font Book, you may need to download fonts from third-party sources, like the ones mentioned above. Here’s how to go about it:

  1. Visit a third-party font source like DaFont in your browser and download the font you want to your Mac.
  2. Head to the Finder app and select the Downloads folder from the sidebar or from the Go menu in the menu bar at the top.
  3. Find the font you just downloaded. Font files are typically in .zip format, so unzip the file and open the font folder.

  4. Double-click the font file, which will usually have a .OTF or .TTF extension, among others, mentioned earlier.

  5. A dialog box will appear showing a preview of the font and prompting you to confirm the installation. Click the Install button to add the font to your Mac.

The Font Book app will now open, showing the installed font, which you can use across supported apps on your Mac.

Other methods to manually install third-party fonts on your Mac include:

  • Dragging the font file from Finder’s Downloads folder directly into the Font Book app.
  • In Font Book, click File in the menu bar and select Add Fonts to Current User. Then, select the font you want to install and follow the on-screen prompts.

How to use installed fonts on Mac

The method for using installed fonts on a Mac can vary for different apps. For example, Pages offers a native way to access fonts within the app, which is different from how designers use fonts in Photoshop.

However, a general method to use an installed font—though it may not work in all apps—is as follows:

  1. With the app open, press Command+T. Or from the menu bar, click Format > Show Fonts or Format > Font > Show Fonts, depending on the app.

  2. When this opens a font window, select the text you want to change and choose your desired font.

Certain fonts you install on your Mac may be too small to read in their default size. Thankfully, you can change the font size in Finder for such fonts to improve their readability.

How to manage your Mac fonts

If you no longer need a font and want to keep your font list tidy, you can deactivate or delete it in the Font Book app, as shown below.

Deactivate a font:

  1. Open Font Book on your Mac.
  2. Select the font you want to deactivate.
  3. Click Edit in the menu bar and choose Deactivate, or you can simply right-click on the installed font and select Deactivate.

  4. Confirm your action by clicking Deactivate Font.

You can reactivate the font whenever you need it by following the above steps. Just select Activate instead of Deactivate from the Edit menu.

Delete a font:

  1. Open Font Book.
  2. Select the font you want to delete.
  3. Press the Delete key to delete the font.
  4. Click Remove Fonts or Remove Non-System Fonts to confirm the action.

What to do if the installed fonts don’t show up on Mac?

If a font you’ve just added to your Mac isn’t showing up in the apps you need it, here are some troubleshooting steps you can try:

  • Restart your applications: Sometimes, simply closing and reopening the app you need the font in can help refresh it and make the font appear.
  • Restart your Mac: If the font is still not showing up, try restarting your Mac. This will give your device a fresh start and help the font be recognized across all your apps.
  • Check the font format: Review the font formats that Mac supports, which we’ve mentioned earlier. If the format of the font you’re trying to install isn’t supported, it won’t work. Download a compatible format and add it to your Mac using the steps covered above.
  • Validate the font: If you’re having trouble with a font, you can validate it using Font Book. Open the Font Book app, select the font, click File in the menu bar, and then choose Validate Selection. A green icon next to the font indicates it passed the validation, a yellow icon suggests a warning, and a red icon means it failed and won’t work on your system. You can remove a failed font by ticking the box next to it and selecting Remove Ticked.
  • Redownload and reinstall the font: If none of the above solutions work, try deleting the font (using the steps listed above) and then redownloading and reinstalling it on your Mac.

Signing off…

By following the simple steps in this article, you can easily install new fonts on your Mac whenever needed. Remember, when you install fonts on your Mac, they are typically added to your current user account. If you want the fonts to be available to all users, you can adjust this in the Font Book installation settings.

You can also install custom fonts on an iPhone or iPad if you’re into personalization.

Also read:

  • How to change font size in Finder on Mac
  • How to install Homebrew on Mac
  • How to change font style in Notes app on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
  • How to Change Fonts on iPhone
