content.rendered:
With so many available options, choosing the best virtual private network (VPN) can be daunting. It’s essential to know what features to look for to ensure the service you select matches your needs and preferences. If you’re still on the fence about which VPN to choose for your Mac and need to do some research before committing, this article has you covered.

Below are all the features you need to consider to help you decide on a VPN service. What’s more, I’ll also teach you how to set up a VPN on your Mac. Let’s get going!

Table of Contents
  • Why you may need to set up a VPN for your Mac?
  • Benefits of using VPN on Mac
  • What to consider when choosing a VPN for macOS
    • 1. Location/server coverage
    • 2. Data cap
    • 3. Security
    • 4. Logging, tracking, and privacy
    • 5. Encryption protocol
    • 6. Versatility
    • 7. Number of connected devices
    • 8. Price
    • 9. Customer support
  • How to set up VPN on macOS
    • Subscribe to a VPN service
    • Connect to an existing VPN on your Mac
    • Manually setup a VPN on a Mac

Why you may need to set up a VPN for your Mac?

The primary reason why you’d need a VPN is to conceal your online activity. Every device connected to the Internet has its own unique Internet Protocol (IP) address.

Over time, IP addresses have been associated with a geographic location, even accurate enough to tell you the city you’re in. This can pose several risks, such as:

  • Reveal who you are to the website you’re checking
  • Show your location to your email recipients
  • Have your internet service provider (ISP) track your activity and sell your data

Benefits of using VPN on Mac

  • A VPN can hide your IP address and conceal internet traffic that can be intercepted when connected to poorly secured or compromised Wi-Fi networks.
  • It prevents numerous corporations, websites, apps, and hackers from tracking your online activity and hides your online identity so you can browse the internet anonymously and securely.
  • You can also use a VPN on your Mac to relocate and access the internet from servers far from you, bypassing various online blocks and restrictions, like movies or shows unavailable for local streaming.

While VPNs are more commonly used on computers, phone users should also consider using them to offer the same protection on their devices. If you own an iPhone, here’s how VPN works on an iPhone.

What to consider when choosing a VPN for macOS

Now that you’re convinced of VPNs’ utility, consider these factors when choosing the best VPN for Mac.

1. Location/server coverage

Depending on your usage, you may want to get a VPN with many server locations.

A VPN server near you can be ideal for online gaming since it ensures a responsive connection without lags. However, having several locations is vital if you often need to bypass geo-blockers, such as for streaming content only available in a particular area.

If that’s you, then you need to consider where the VPN’s servers are located. For example, choose a VPN service with a long list of US exit nodes if you need a US IP address to access a particular site you can’t access from where you are.

2. Data cap

Many free VPNs on Macs and other devices place a monthly data cap on their services, which can be a significant restriction if you use a large amount of data. Other services do not cap your internet usage.

Different VPN protocols also use differing amounts of data. The protocols that offer the most security, like OpenVPN, use a moderate amount of data compared to those offering minimal security and privacy.

3. Security

Even if privacy or security is not an issue for you, everyone should consider using a VPN if they regularly use unsecured, public Wi-Fi networks, like connections in hotels and coffee shops.

For all you know, their router has compromised firmware. Worse, it can be actively logging your data. In the case of a poorly secured network, other users may be able to probe and hack sensitive data from your device.

You may want to look for other security features for your VPN service. Two-factor authentication (2FA) prevents hackers from accessing your network in case of compromised credentials.

A kill switch is another desirable feature that helps ensure security for your connection. It automatically blocks internet access on your device if your VPN isn’t working to prevent it from making unprotected connections.

4. Logging, tracking, and privacy

We all want complete anonymity. But the reality is that all VPN services still do log and keep user data. Different VPNs have different policies on what data they hold. Some keep a record of all your activities, while others are less invasive and only keep a log of when they connected and disconnected.

It’s crucial to check the logging policy of the VPN service you’re eyeing to see what logs they maintain. You may opt for VPNs that have a “no-logs” policy. These services won’t follow, collect, or monitor your online browsing activities.

Similarly, many VPN services—especially free VPNs—make money by selling user data to other businesses for marketing purposes. Inspect your VPN’s privacy policy thoroughly to determine whether they collect and share your data with any third party.

5. Encryption protocol 

You’d want to use a robust VPN protocol to protect yourself from cyberattacks and hacks. OpenVPN is one of the safest and best VPN protocols available. Since it’s open-source, anyone can inspect and check for security vulnerabilities.

Meanwhile, it’s best to avoid PPTP and L2TP/IPSec for their known security flaws that make them susceptible to hacks.

6. Versatility

You should check if the VPN service supports different platforms and operating systems. This can be crucial if you have several devices running on different systems or when it’s for business.

The VPN you’re eyeing should have dedicated apps for different platforms, such as Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. It would be even better if you could configure it to be used on routers, smart TVs, and gaming consoles.

7. Number of connected devices

Many people use their laptops and phones at different times. To ensure safe browsing, each of these devices should be covered by your VPN. If you’re using multiple devices, it’s just given that you’ll get a VPN service that provides coverage to multiple devices.

Look for VPN services that cover at least up to five devices. It would be ideal for getting one that allows you to connect an unlimited number of devices simultaneously, like Surfshark.

8. Price

The pricing of a VPN for Macs can range from free to around $100 per year. The most important thing is to find a balance between features and price.

If you’re looking for a comprehensive package with advanced features, you should be prepared to pay more. But if you just need a basic VPN for occasional use, there are plenty of affordable options.

Some VPN providers also offer lifetime subscriptions. Others have free trials or money-back guarantees that let you try the service before committing to it. 

9. Customer support

While prompt and helpful customer support is hard to find, you should still consider this when deciding on your VPN service. It’s ideal to find a service that offers 24/7 live chat support, just in case you run into any issues.

How to set up VPN on macOS

Now that you know what to look for in a VPN, it’s time to set one up on your Mac. You can get one through a third-party VPN service or manual configuration.

Subscribe to a VPN service

The easiest way to use a VPN service is to subscribe to one. The process can vary depending on the service, but it generally follows a similar pattern. I’ve decided to try Surfshark for this article since they’re offering a free 7-day trial.

  1. Download the VPN app on your Mac through the App Store or their website.
  2. Sign up for an account.
  3. If the service is paid, choose the subscription you prefer. 
  4. Connect to the server of your choice.

Connect to an existing VPN on your Mac

If you have a VPN on an existing internet connection, you can directly connect to it on your Mac:

  1. Choose Apple menu → System Settings.
  2. Select your VPN service on the list on the left of the window.
  3. Enable the service on the right pane.

Manually setup a VPN on a Mac

You may connect to a VPN service provider through your Mac’s built-in networking framework. To do this:

  1. Click the Apple menu → System Settings.

  2. Select Network.
  3. Click the three-dot icon at the bottom of the right pane.

  4. Select Add VPN Configuration → Select the type of VPN. For Surf Shark, it’s IKEv2.

  5. Choose a name for the VPN service and enter the required details, such as Server Address and Remote ID.
  6. Select Create.

Wrapping up…

VPNs are a great way to ensure online anonymity, privacy, and security. By connecting to a VPN server, you can encrypt your traffic and hide your identity from anyone who might be spying on you.

When choosing a VPN service for your Mac, consider the above factors to help you maximize your investment. What are your dealbreakers when it comes to VPNs? Share them down below!

FAQs

Is VPN free on Mac?

Macs do not have their built-in VPN, but the macOS interface allows you to establish a connection with a VPN server. This means you can connect to a private network if you have all the required information. You may also download a free third-party VPN service.

Is using a VPN on a Mac legal?

VPNs are legal, regardless of which device you’re using. However, some countries have VPN restrictions, so check the laws in your jurisdiction before using a VPN.

Is there an Apple VPN for Mac?

No, although there are many third-party VPN providers for Mac. You may also connect to a VPN using an existing connection on your Mac.

mainEntity.name: Why isn't my Live Wallpaper working?

acceptedAnswer.text: If Live Wallpaper isn't working on your iPhone, ensure it supports this feature and has the Haptic Touch feature enabled. Additionally, Live Wallpapers won't animate in Low Power Mode, so make sure it's turned off. Go to Settings > Battery and toggle off the Low Power Mode switch.

mainEntity.name: Do Live Wallpapers drain the battery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but only slightly. Since Live Wallpapers animate only when you're on the Lock Screen, the battery drain is minimal. However, frequent use can have a noticeable impact on older devices.

mainEntity.name: Is VPN free on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: Macs do not have their built-in VPN, but the macOS interface allows you to establish a connection with a VPN server. This means you can connect to a private network if you have all the required information. You may also download a free third-party VPN service.

mainEntity.name: Is using a VPN on a Mac legal?

acceptedAnswer.text: VPNs are legal, regardless of which device you’re using. However, some countries have VPN restrictions, so check the laws in your jurisdiction before using a VPN.

mainEntity.name: Is there an Apple VPN for Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, although there are many third-party VPN providers for Mac. You may also connect to a VPN using an existing connection on your Mac.

title.rendered: Best HomeKit Compatible Door Locks in 2026

content.rendered:
Gone are the days when people wanted to build their sweet home. Now they dream about a smart home. And the first thing you should install a smart lock. This ensures the full safety of your home, belongings, and most importantly, your loved ones. But which smart lock to choose? Instead of meandering through the jungle of products online, check some of the best HomeKit compatible door locks here.

1. August AUG-SL-CON-S03

August smart door lock works on its DoorSense technology, which lets you know if the door is locked securely or not. This technology keeps you alert about your home’s security. Another security feature is tracking of activity at the doorstep; August’s Activity Feed continuously monitors who is coming and going.

When guests arrive, you can give them hourly or weekly access of August smart lock. A notable feature of this smart door lock is it locks automatically behind you and unlocks when you go close to the lock.

USP: Constant tracking of activity
Check out on Amazon

2. Kwikset

Here is a smart deadbolt door lock with a touchscreen. You can set a passcode to unlock it or use Apple HomeKit and command Siri to open the door. You can use the Premis app or Apple Home app to schedule access for certain times of days. Moreover, you can easily send, delete, add, or disable access codes.

When you rush to office in a hurry and forget if you have locked the front door, you can check the status of your lock by using Premis app. You can also use Siri to check the status of your door lock.

USP: 30 customizable user codes
Check out on Amazon

3. Schlage

Schlage has made it simple to lock and unlock your front door with a voice command or a touchscreen. This digital door lock enables you to set an access code to open the door. This feature removes the need of keeping keys with you always. At the same time, you can share access with your friends and family with a few easy steps taken on Schlage iOS app.

You can use your iPad or Apple TV as a hub to connect this smart lock with the devices and use the Home app to operate the lock from a distance.

USP: One-year battery life
Check out on Amazon

4. Yale Security

If you keep regular hours at home, you can create daily schedules to lock the front door of your home with Yale Security. By creating schedules, you can ensure that your smart front door is locked at a specific time each day. When you set up a schedule, you are worry-free of locking the door before you go to bed.

Are you using Apple TV at home? Turn the device into a hub to access Yale’s smart lock from anywhere. Make sure you have an Apple TV 4TH generation or later. You can also use a backlit touchscreen to lock and unlock the door with a pin code.

USP: Backlit touchscreen
Check out on Amazon

  • Best HomeKit Secure Video cameras

title.rendered: Best iPhone 15 Plus cases in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple introduced the iPhone 15 Plus at the Wonderlust event. With new camera upgrades and USB-C support, the device has already created a buzz in the market. If you have brought yourself one, then you must protect it with a top-quality case. I have scoured the internet and found the best iPhone 15 Plus cases for you.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Apple FineWoven with MagSafe – Editor's Choice
  • 2. CASETiFY Bounce Case – Extra protection on edges
  • 3. Spigen tough armor MagFit case – Trusted brand
  • 4. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro – Quality material for durable build
  • 5. ESR – Adjustable stand for camera
  • 6. totallee super thin – Lightweight iPhone 15 Plus case
  • 7. Mujjo leather case – Flawless finish and safety
  • 8. Benks – Best iPhone 15 Plus protection case
  • 9. TORRAS Magnetic – Instant charging at your fingertips
  • 10. FireNova – Extra protection from air cushions

1. Apple FineWoven with MagSafe – Editor’s Choice

Apple coined a new term FineWoven to showcase its sincere efforts towards eco-friendly products. Following this, the Cupertino giant has designed a stunning FineWoven case with MagSafe for your iPhone 15 Plus.

The faux leather finish gives your new smartphone a luxurious look without compromising its safety— something you would expect from any of the best iPhone 15 Plus cases. Everything in a color palette that effortlessly vibes with your style.

With a perfect magnetic alignment, this cover blesses you with an easy Snap-On fast-charging experience anywhere and anytime. In addition, the top-quality material wraps your iPhone snugly from all four edges. Thus promising unprecedented safety from bruises, scratches, drops, and falls. FYI, Apple cases undergo thousands of hours of rigorous testing to give ultimate protection to your precious iPhone. 

Pros

  • Made of FineWoven material  
  • Sturdy build for longer use 
  • Perfect magnetic alignment  
  • Multiple color options 

Cons

  • Might feel heavy  

Check out on Amazon

2. CASETiFY Bounce Case – Extra protection on edges

You must have heard about bouncy balls. Now, meet the CASETiFY Bounce case that offers a stylish way to protect your iPhone 15 Plus. Designed to perfection, this amazing mobile cover adorns a sleek and lightweight design that easily fits in your pockets.

The Bounce corners feature extended bumper edges paired with air cavities, offering top structural brilliance and performance. Moreover, the MagSafe compatibility keeps your smartphone charged and always running.  

If you are clumsy like me, this stellar CASETiFY iPhone 15 Plus case is perfect for you. Here, you get 6x military grade and 21.3ft drop protection at your fingertips. The raised bezels running across the cover add another layer of safety. Now, you can finally shoo away all the unavoidable adversities that will likely diminish the charm of your iPhone 15 Plus.   

Pros

  • Extra protection at edges 
  • MagSafe charging support 
  • EcoShock support 

Cons

  • A bit expensive

Check out on Amazon

3. Spigen tough armor MagFit case – Trusted brand

As the name suggests, the Spigen tough armor MagFit case is the ultimate safeguard for your iPhone 15 Plus. Measuring 6.58 x 3.30 x 0.51”, the mobile cover completely fits the 6.7” iPhone 15 Plus from all the edges for a close-ended snug fit.

In addition, Spigen has used a combo of polycarbonate, TPU, and Impact Foam in making this rugged case. The MagSafe support with perfect magnetic alignment is just the icing on the cake.  

Built-in kickstands are one of the best features of tough armor cases. With the iPhone 15, you won’t need any other device for 4K streaming. The kickstand on this case allows you to watch movies and shows comfortably. Furthermore, the raised edges keep the screen and camera lens safe from scratches. 

Pros

  • Raised edges for added safety 
  • Military-grade protection 
  • Built-in kickstand for content streaming 

Cons

  • Less flexible  

Check out on Amazon 

4. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro – Quality material for durable build

Enjoy the best viewing experience with the SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro iPhone 15 Plus case. Confused? Well, this MagSafe-compatible case comes with an attached kickstand that helps you place and switch your phone screen between portrait and landscape orientations in seconds. Moreover, as it is made with high-grade polycarbonate material paired with TPU bumpers, you don’t have to worry about scratches ruining the beauty of your iPhone 15 Plus.   

Quality is never an issue with SUPCASE. Your iPhone 15 Plus fits perfectly in the Unicorn Beetle Pro rugged case. Thus, saving it from accidental slips and drops. It also offers 15ft drop test protection for your pricey smartphone. Raised bezels around the camera and screen prevent tiny scratches.

Pros

  • Raised bezels and precise cuts 
  • Solid build for extended usage 
  • MagSafe support 

Cons

  • It might feel hard to touch 

Check out on SUPCASE 

5. ESR – Adjustable stand for camera 

If you need some extra protection for your iPhone 15 camera, ESR has got you covered. The brand has created a rock-solid case with a stash stand that protects your rear camera outlay from getting scratched when kept flat on surfaces. This adjustable stand, made using a durable zinc alloy, also helps you station your iPhone 15 Plus in landscape mode during streaming, gaming, or FaceTime.  

Promising military-grade protection, the ESR iPhone 15 Plus case is crafted using a combination of polycarbonate and silicone. The build covers your smartphone from all the edges tightly, leaving no space for dust or slip-offs. Moreover, the rigid material absorbs all the shocks from drops, bumps, and hits. There is also a soft microfiber lining on the inside that helps avoid scratches.   

The ESR iPhone 15 Plus case features powerful magnets that work well with MagSafe chargers and accessories. The list includes MagSafe wallet, power bank, car chargers, etc. With this amazing case, you can keep your iPhone 15 Plus running all day. Get the best of safety and design with this stunning case.  

Pros

  • Strong silicone and PC build 
  • Adjustable stash stand 
  • Works with MagSafe accessories 
  • Durable finish 

Cons

  • Mediocre quality of stash stand

Check out on Amazon 

6. totallee super thin – Lightweight iPhone 15 Plus case

Say no to bulky cases with totallee super thin case. With this beautiful case, you can add an ultra-thin layer of protection to your iPhone 15 Plus. Do you know that this cover features an ultra-thin design measuring 0.02” and weighing 0.1 oz? Trust me; super thin case by totallee is one of the best picks you can try your hands on. It specializes in offering top-notch security to your iPhone without being bulky on your hands.  

Crafted with superior-quality products, the super thin case saves your iPhone from minor falls and bruises to help keep your iPhone new for a long. Further, the raised lips running across the corners of this stellar case help prevent damage to the 48MP camera outlay in your iPhone 15 Plus. Because no matter how much you love your iPhone, you cannot keep it in your hands all day. If you have a knack for minimal design and top performance – this beauty is just for you.   

Pros

  • Made of best materials 
  • Durable and stylish 
  • Raised bezels for camera lens 

Cons

  • Straightforward design 

Check out on totallee 

7. Mujjo leather case – Flawless finish and safety 

Mujjo is known for its quality iPhone 15 Plus cases. The latest creation from the manufacturer is the complete leather case that offers top-notch safety to your iPhone 15 Plus. Wrapped in rich Ecco leather, the case fits effortlessly around your smartphone to protect it from impromptu slips or drops. title.rendered: Best smart plugs for HomeKit in 2026

content.rendered:
Your home automation exercise gives you full control of all the electronic devices with a touch or voice. To build a smart home, you can either use HomeKit compatible devices, or you need to install smart plugs to make your appliances listen to you. But before you buy one, make sure you choose the best HomeKit smart plugs.

While you are looking for a HomeKit-enabled smart plug or outlet, care should be taken to select a perfect product that is not beyond your budget. A few brands have carved a niche in this segment. They sell the best HomeKit-compatible smart plugs at affordable prices. So, Let’s navigate to this exclusive list and pick out the best smart plug for your home.

Table of Content
  • 1. VOCOlinc Homekit smart plug – Work with Alexa
  • 2. Satechi Dual Smart Plug – Real-Time Power Monitoring
  • 3. Wemo Insight Smart Plug – Manage Energy Costs From Anywhere
  • 4. meross smart plug mini – No Hub Needed
  • 5. Eve Energy – Simple and sleek
  • 6.  Leviton Smart Wi-Fi Mini Plug-In Switch (2nd gen) – Supports up to 15A

1. VOCOlinc Homekit smart plug – Work with Alexa

VOCOlinc has designed a space-saving smart plug to control your electronic devices. Once you connect the plug to your home Wi-fi network, you can control it from anywhere from Apple Home (iOS) or VOCOlinc cloud, which works on Android devices.

A notable feature of this plug is scheduling. You can set schedules to turn on and off your electronics automatically; this certainly saves your time in the morning. The compact design of this plug never blocks another socket.

Check out on Amazon

2. Satechi Dual Smart Plug – Real-Time Power Monitoring

Make your life easy with Satechi’s HomeKit compatible smart plug, which can be controlled via Apple’s HomeKit app or Satechi’s free iOS app. This dual smart outlet connects with your existing 2.4GHz wireless network. To save your time and energy, you can create scenes and scheduled routines.

If you are using high-powered appliances, you can monitor power consumption in real-time. You can reduce power usage by scheduling appliances to switch off when not needed.

Checkout on Amazon

3. Wemo Insight Smart Plug – Manage Energy Costs From Anywhere

WeMo is a leading brand in manufacturing smart plugs for home automation. This HomeKit compatible plug is actually smart as you can use AwayMode, which turns lights on and off. This creates an illusion that you are at home and robbers barely think of breaking in your home. Thus, you can protect your home even when you are away from your abode. This feature is helpful in the absence of HomeKit compatible smart door locks.

You can control your electronic devices from the couch, coffee shop, or the Caribbean by using free WeMo app on your iOS device.

Checkout on Amazon

4. meross smart plug mini – No Hub Needed

For those looking for the best HomeKit smart plugs, you can consider the meross smart plug mini. This compact smart plug is compatible with Apple HomeKit. In addition, it allows you to control devices remotely using Thread via devices such as HomePod, Apple TV 4K, Apple TV HD, iPhone, or iPad.

You can easily schedule lights, fans, and other appliances to turn on and off automatically. The smart plug is also compatible with other popular voice assistants such as Alexa and Google Assistant, allowing you to control your devices hands-free.

For those who are safely concerned, the smart plug is made of PC flame retardant material and has been approved for safety and quality assurance. Even if you aren’t convinced yet, the meross smart plug is certified by ETL and FCC.

As for power, it can support up to 15A. All of these features make it a perfect option.

Check out on: Amazon | meross

5. Eve Energy – Simple and sleek

Eve Energy is a powerful and versatile smart plug and power meter that allows users to control their lights and appliances using their iPhone, iPad, or even with the built-in switch. You can also schedule to switch between the connected devices.

Setting up this tool is easy as all you have to do is turn it on, and it will be detected by your iPhone or iPad using Bluetooth. The best part is that with this HomeKit smart plug, you can control it from anywhere you want, even if you’re away from home.

Apart from the ability to control devices with a schedule, you can use this smart plug to track power consumption and see the projected cost based on your electricity rate. This is something that impressed me a lot since that can help you to optimize your energy consumption.

For privacy concerns, Eve won’t have any access to your data since there is no cloud service to store your data. And above all, because of its small and sleek design, you can fit it into any outlet.

Many users have reported that the installation guide could have been improved, but I guess they might be unaware of the Thread, which easily connects to your HomePod, Apple TV 3rd gen, and other devices.

Check out on Amazon

6.  Leviton Smart Wi-Fi Mini Plug-In Switch (2nd gen) – Supports up to 15A

The Leviton D215P-2RW Decora Smart Wi-Fi Mini Plug-In Switch (2nd Gen) is another great HomeKit-compatible smart plug that can conveniently turn any home into a smart home. You can easily schedule lights, fans, and other appliances to turn on and off automatically.

You can also use voice commands to control your devices hands-free. With so many options, some might wonder if the smart plug will be big, but that’s not true. Instead, the device is compact and allows you to stack two mini smart plugs in the same outlet.

Along with that, you can schedule connected devices to turn on and off based on sunrise, sunset, and whatever time you want to. As for safety, the mini plug is made of PC flame retardant material and has been certified by ETL and FCC. The Leviton smart plug also supports up to 15A.

Check out on Amazon

Make your home appliances smart!

A smart plug makes your everyday life easy and comfortable. The real idea of controlling your home appliances with a touch or voice is exciting. If you have been using traditional wall outlets for many years, you can start with a single unit, and then entire home.

More interesting reads for you!

  • Best HomeKit Garage Door Openers

title.rendered: Best waterproof cases for iPhone 14 and 14 Pro in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple’s iPhone 14 series has spectacular features. Water resistance might tempt you to spend more time underwater. And I bet you want to spend more time taking aqua shots and videos without fearing damage to your ports. So, here are the best waterproof cases for iPhone 14 and 14 Pro. They prevent water damage as well as bumps, drops, and scratches.

Table of Contents
  1. Ghostek NAUTICAL – Editor's choice
  2. AICase waterproof case – Toughness personified
  3. Ezanmull cover – IPX8-certified waterproof
  4. SPIDERCASE waterproof case – Slimmest
  5. Temdan waterproof case – Best screen cover
  6. Protebox waterproof case – Best fit

1. Ghostek NAUTICAL – Editor’s choice

The Ghostek Nautical is your go-to for the entire iPhone 14 series. The cases are snug-fit with a non-slip grip on the back. Despite its enormous protective accessories, it’s MagSafe compatible. And you can charge your iPhone 14 wirelessly while rocking the case.

Although the Ghostek Nautical case looks heavy-duty, it bears a combination of polycarbonate, rubber, and thermoplastic materials, giving it a super-light quality. The case has a screen guard and camera lens cover with raised edges. It’s also shockproof-tested and trusted to withstand more than 3 meters tall fall, giving your iPhone 14 all-around protection.

This one is also waterproof and IP68-certified with a dustproof feature. You’ll also appreciate the crisp detail on the Ghostek Nautical case. It has clean carves around ports and openings, so there would be no intrusion to functionality as far as we can tell.

Pros

  • It can last 30 minutes at 3 meters underwater.
  • Precisely cut openings to reveal ports.
  • It supports wireless charging.
  • It has a lens cover.

Cons

  • It can feel a bit bulky on the hand.

Check out on Ghostek: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro 

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Pro

2. AICase waterproof case – Toughness personified

The AICase brand has been in the business of making tough phone cases, but this new generation is more than two times stronger. The case material is military-grade thermoplastic polyurethane; this can protect your iPhone 14 or 14 Pro against up to 3 meters tall fall shock.

The AICase waterproof iPhone 14 case features a magnetic component on the back cover to give it a firm grip on your cardholder and phone mount. The magnetic feature also gives it super-fast and reliable MagSafe wireless charging support. And if you need extra power on the go, you can attach your battery pack to the MagSafe icon on the back.

The package also includes a sensitive HD screen guard. The device is waterproof and dustproof, and IP68-certified. When tested, the AICase lasts for 30 minutes at an approximate maximum depth of 3 meters underwater. In addition, the raised edges around the camera region are as high as 0.5mm with lens covers, enhancing shockproofing.

Pros

  • It combines sophistication with functionality.
  • MagSafe-charging-compatible.
  • Ideal for more rugged activities.
  • The magnetic unit at the back is suitable for holding card holders, phone mounts, and battery packs.

Cons

  • It can be a bit bulky at the back.

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

3. Ezanmull cover – IPX8-certified waterproof

The Ezanmull iPhone 14 case is an excellent choice to add more elegance to your iPhone 14 and 14 Pro. The entire body is thermoplastic polyurethane. And in addition to a built-in HD-supported screen protector, this one also has hard raised edges around the camera protection.

It’s waterproof, and you can dive as deep as 2 meters for an hour. However, you might opt for other options if you want a dustproof feature since this is only IPX8-certified. The case has a clear back with support for Qi and MagSafe wireless charging.

The Ezanmull case allows you to flex your iPhone 14 since its clear back displays your iPhone’s glory. It feels light to handle despite its protecting power.

Pros

  • Waterproof quality (IPX8-certified).
  • It supports wireless charging.
  • Raised edges offer extra protection.

Cons

  • No color options are available.

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Pro

4. SPIDERCASE waterproof case – Slimmest

The Spidercase waterproof case is slim and provides 360-degree protection for your iPhone 14 and 14 Pro. The entire case is a polyurethane material lined with polycarbonate on the inside to enhance its shockproof feature. It also features a 9H HD tempered glass screen protector that doesn’t reduce screen sensitivity.

And no worries if you prefer the back covered. The Spidercase case makes little difference on the back case by covering it with a rubber material. The hollow opening on the back still reveals your iPhone’s glory, though.

Ultimately, your iPhone 14 gets all-around protection while you surf the tidal water parts, take underwater pictures, or make underwater videos. The case is also MIL-STD-certified. Hence, it’s shockproof and dustproof. Fall tests showed that this withstands up to 3.7 meters tall fall.

Pros

  • Inner polycarbonate lining enhances protection.
  • It can last up to an hour at a 3-meter underwater dive.
  • Wireless-charging-compatible.
  • Simple, sturdy, and withstands up to 3.7 meters tall fall.
  • Protective design.

Cons

  • Only available in black.

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Pro

5. Temdan waterproof case – Best screen cover

The Temdan waterproof case is another 360 degrees cover. It features 0.33mm 9H HD picture quality tempered glass with a camera covering to protect the lens. We thought this thickness would alter screen functionality, but we were surprised it’s as responsive as the bare screen. The entire body is sturdy, as it comes in military-grade polycarbonate material.

In addition, the case is transparent so that your iPhone can be seen, but it still supports MagSafe and Qi wireless charging. This Temdan case is IP68-certified and waterproof to 1.5m for 30 minutes. It is ideal for most water activities even though this depth is less than expected. Additionally, it is shockproof, dustproof, and can withstand 3.6m high falls.

Pros

  • It supports wireless charging.
  • IP68-certified, shockproof, waterproof, and dustproof.
  • Sealed edges provide all-around protection.
  • The 0.33mm thick HD screen guard is shockproof to the screen.

Cons

  • The sound output is poor.

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

6. Protebox waterproof case – Best fit

The Protebox case shares a similar simplistic structure with the Dewfoam brand. However, it provides a fit for all iPhone 14 models. So you’ll find your iPhone 14’s choice on the market.

The material on this one is polyethylene terephthalate plastic, so you might not expect much from the case in terms of toughness. However, you can trust its waterproof feature to take you down 2 meters underwater for an hour.

This one also features a touch-screen compatible screen guard plus the back cover. Thus, like many waterproof cases, it offers 360-degree sealing, preventing water from perforating into your iPhone’s units. The raised plastic region around the camera also includes a lens cover; this is handy for protecting your iPhone’s back and camera lens.

Pros

  • It can last up to an hour at a 2-meter depth underwater.
  • Simplistic design.
  • Raised edges around the camera protect the lens.
  • Available for all iPhone 14 models.

Cons

  • You can’t guarantee adequate shock protection.

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14

Conclusion

If your iPhone can survive for up to 30 minutes underwater, there are chances it’ll thrive longer when covered with a water-resistant case. Get one of these cases today and add another protective layer to your precious iPhone 14 or 14 Pro. What type of iPhone 14 case do you currently use? We’d love to know in the comment section below.

Read more:

  • iPhone 14 series: Design, features, price, and more
  • Download iPhone 14 wallpapers

@graph.name: Ghostek NAUTICAL
@graph.description: The Ghostek Nautical is your go-to for the entire iPhone 14 series. The cases are snug-fit with a non-slip grip on the back. Despite its enormous protective accessories, it’s MagSafe compatible. And you can charge your iPhone 14 wirelessly while rocking the case. Although the Ghostek Nautical case looks heavy-duty, it bears a combination of polycarbonate, rubber, and thermoplastic materials, giving it a super-light quality. The case has a screen guard and camera lens cover with raised edges. It’s also shockproof-tested and trusted to withstand more than 3 meters tall fall, giving your iPhone 14 all-around protection. This one is also waterproof and IP68-certified with a dustproof feature. You’ll also appreciate the crisp detail on the Ghostek Nautical case. It has clean carves around ports and openings, so there would be no intrusion to functionality as far as we can tell.

@graph.name: AICase waterproof case – Toughness personified
@graph.description: The AICase brand has been in the business of making tough phone cases, but this new generation is more than two times stronger. The case material is military-grade thermoplastic polyurethane; this can protect your iPhone 14 or 14 Pro against up to 3 meters tall fall shock. The AICase waterproof iPhone 14 case features a magnetic component on the back cover to give it a firm grip on your cardholder and phone mount. The magnetic feature also gives it super-fast and reliable MagSafe wireless charging support. And if you need extra power on the go, you can attach your battery pack to the MagSafe icon on the back. The package also includes a sensitive HD screen guard. The device is waterproof and dustproof, and IP68-certified. When tested, the AICase lasts for 30 minutes at an approximate maximum depth of 3 meters underwater. In addition, the raised edges around the camera region are as high as 0.5mm with lens covers, enhancing shockproofing.

@graph.name: Ezanmull cover – IPX8-certified waterproof
@graph.description: The Ezanmull iPhone 14 case is an excellent choice to add more elegance to your iPhone 14 and 14 Pro. The entire body is thermoplastic polyurethane. And in addition to a built-in HD-supported screen protector, this one also has hard raised edges around the camera protection. It’s waterproof, and you can dive as deep as 2 meters for an hour. However, you might opt for other options if you want a dustproof feature since this is only IPX8-certified. The case has a clear back with support for Qi and MagSafe wireless charging. The Ezanmull case allows you to flex your iPhone 14 since its clear back displays your iPhone’s glory. It feels light to handle despite its protecting power.

@graph.name: SPIDERCASE waterproof case – Slimmest
@graph.description: The Spidercase waterproof case is slim and provides 360-degree protection for your iPhone 14 and 14 Pro. The entire case is a polyurethane material lined with polycarbonate on the inside to enhance its shockproof feature. It also features a 9H HD tempered glass screen protector that doesn’t reduce screen sensitivity. And no worries if you prefer the back covered. The Spidercase case makes little difference on the back case by covering it with a rubber material. The hollow opening on the back still reveals your iPhone’s glory, though. Ultimately, your iPhone 14 gets all-around protection while you surf the tidal water parts, take underwater pictures, or make underwater videos. The case is also MIL-STD-certified. Hence, it’s shockproof and dustproof. Fall tests showed that this withstands up to 3.7 meters tall fall.

@graph.name: Temdan waterproof case – Best screen cover
@graph.description: The Temdan waterproof case is another 360 degrees cover. It features 0.33mm 9H HD picture quality tempered glass with a camera covering to protect the lens. We thought this thickness would alter screen functionality, but we were surprised it’s as responsive as the bare screen. The entire body is sturdy, as it comes in military-grade polycarbonate material. In addition, the case is transparent so that your iPhone can be seen, but it still supports MagSafe and Qi wireless charging. This Temdan case is IP68-certified and waterproof to 1.5m for 30 minutes. It is ideal for most water activities even though this depth is less than expected. Additionally, it is shockproof, dustproof, and can withstand 3.6m high falls.

@graph.name: Protebox waterproof case – Best fit
@graph.description: The Protebox case shares a similar simplistic structure with the Dewfoam brand. However, it provides a fit for all iPhone 14 models. So you’ll find your iPhone 14’s choice on the market. The material on this one is polyethylene terephthalate plastic, so you might not expect much from the case in terms of toughness. However, you can trust its waterproof feature to take you down 2 meters underwater for an hour. This one also features a touch-screen compatible screen guard plus the back cover. Thus, like many waterproof cases, it offers 360-degree sealing, preventing water from perforating into your iPhone’s units. The raised plastic region around the camera also includes a lens cover; this is handy for protecting your iPhone’s back and camera lens.

content.rendered:
What if I tell you that I am here to introduce you to one of your long-lost friends? Confused? Well, I am talking about origami. I know most of you must have read this word after ages. Well, then, you are in for a treat here. Get ready to welcome origami back into your life with cool, trendy iPhone wallpapers.  

Add a new aesthetic to your iPhone with these wallpapers showcasing some interesting origami designs. Not to forget, you will be spoilt for choice with the color palette adorning each wallpaper. Seeking inspiration from Pinterest and Freepik, our designers have curated the best origami 3D wallpapers for iPhone to please the inner artist in you.  

Tap the download button available at the bottom of every image to add the wallpaper to your iPhone. I know you won’t stop at one! 

1. Play with pyramids origami 3D wallpaper 

Pyramids are spooky. Embrace a new side of eeriness through this beautiful wallpaper that features color pyramids crafted with the magic of origami.

Download

2. Colorful origami butterflies wallpaper

Who doesn’t love butterflies? Hit the download button below this origami wallpaper and bring the beauty of these tiny creatures to your iPhone.  

Download

3. Cool red boat wallpaper for iPhone 

Rekindle your childhood memories with these adorable origami paper boat wallpaper. The red boat in a pool of white will melt your heart for sure. 

Download

4. Serene white paper flowers wallpaper  

White flowers denote serenity. Amid the chaos, these beautiful origami white flowers adorning the wallpaper will soothe your mind instantly.  

Download

5. Lovely swans iPhone wallpaper 

Add a pop of color to your iPhone screen with this colorful wallpaper featuring the ever-so-elegant origami swans. These love preachers will surely brighten up your day.

Download

6. Hanging birds origami iPhone wallpaper 

Since childhood, I have loved watching birds flying high across the blue sky. If you feel the same, welcome these tiny birdies as your next iPhone wallpaper.  

Download

7. Fun animated water boats wallpaper  

Do you like the eye-catching graphics of animated TV shows? If yes, this floating boat wallpaper with cute animation feels will surely pick your interest.  

Download

8. Flashy pyramids 3D wallpaper 

Give your iPhone screen a 3D touch with this exciting wallpaper featuring green and pink pyramids. Tap the Download button below Now. 

Download

9. Cute origami 3D designs

Do you know what’s pretty? Your wallpaper! This orange-themed wallpaper with cute origami swans, flowers, and birds will bring liveliness to your dull iPhone screen instantly.  

Download

10. Origami paper animals

Hey, animal lovers! This wallpaper is a visual treat for you. Enjoy the view of tiny elephants, penguins, and birds whenever you open your iPhone. Cool, right? 

Download

11. Red and yellow hearts origami 3D wallpaper  

Spill the magic of tiny, adorable origami hearts by downloading the given below wallpaper. The yellow heart peeking out will add a special charm to your iPhone.

Download

12. Dark sculpture origami wallpaper

If eccentricity is your taste, you will fall in love with this beautiful sculpture that forms the focus of this wallpaper. Also, let me know if you learn that the man is lost in thoughts or love.  

Download

Add an artistic touch to your iPhone! 

Give your iPhone a touch of origami with these stunning artistic, aesthetic wallpapers. Whether you want to play with colors or add paper animals, these wallpapers will satiate all your whims.  

Our designers have put in their best effort to spoil you for choice. You will fall in love with the style, animation, and unique designs of the wallpapers. So, don’t feel shy while tapping the download button placed below each wallpaper image here. You will love watching these cute origami 3D wallpapers whenever you open your iPhone.  

Thank you for reading, and do let me know your favorite pick!

title.rendered: How to block ads on iPhone and iPad

content.rendered:
Apple prides itself on the range of customization its devices offer to users, but doesn’t provide a default solution to block ads in apps and games on iPhone. 

It also regularly changes its policies and tries to limit third-party apps from offering system-wide ad blocking. But, worry not: there are still a few ways to effectively block ads on iPhone.

  1. Block iPhone game ads by turning off Wi-Fi and Cellular Data
  2. Disable internet access to a particular game
  3. Use AdGuard Pro to block ads in games and apps
Table of Contents
  • 1. Block iPhone game ads by turning off Wi-Fi and Cellular Data
  • 2. Disable internet access to a particular game
  • 3. Use AdGuard Pro to block ads in games and apps

1. Block iPhone game ads by turning off Wi-Fi and Cellular Data

Advertisements rely on a Wi-Fi or Cellular Data connection to serve the user. Without a data network, the code within the app cannot fetch the ads and display them on-screen. This leads to two interesting situations.

First off, most apps will stop showing ads completely when there’s no available data network. Secondly, in some cases, you’ll see a big filled/empty rectangle or block where the ad typically appears.

Overall, this is a quick and easy way to stop getting ads on iPhone games. Disabling the internet also puts a pause on notifications that hinder your gameplay. 

Here’s how to go about it:

  1. Turn off Wi-Fi and Cellular Data from the Control Center. Or, open Settings on your iPhone and tap Wi-Fi. Turn the toggle off. 
  2. Now, repeat the same process for Cellular Data.

  3. Next, Force quit the game (or app). 
    On iPhones with Face-ID: Swipe up from the bottom of the screen, then drag the app card upwards. 
    On iPhones with a Home button: Double tap the Home button to see all open apps. Now, drag the game card up to force close the application.
  4. After a few seconds, open the game again. Since internet connectivity is disabled, you will see no ads.

This is a simple way to turn off ads inside a game on iOS devices. Another quick method is to turn on Airplane Mode on your iPhone. You can use Settings or the Control Center to enable it.

Naturally, by following the above methods, you’ll also be off the grid on WhatsApp, Facebook, iMessage, Skype, Mail, and even iCloud. Basically, any app that relies on a network connection is temporarily disabled. If you use Airplane Mode, you won’t be able to receive calls and texts.

So, is there a way to disable the internet connection for only the game (or particular app) in question and maintain connectivity for the rest of your iPhone’s features? Well, there’s a workaround.

2. Disable internet access to a particular game

Suppose you’re waiting for an important call or text, and in the meantime, you want to play your favorite game free of ads. This is where this clever solution comes in.

  1. Navigate to the Control Center or Settings, and tap Wi-Fi.
  2. Toggle Wi-Fi off.

  3. Next, in Settings, tap Cellular. Make sure the toggle for Cellular Data is on.

  4. Scroll down and under CELLULAR DATA find the particular game (or app). Turn the toggle off for this game.

  5. Force close the game app and relaunch it after a few seconds.

Now, when you play this game, there will be no ads. This is because there’s no active Wi-Fi connection, and Cellular Data for the particular app is turned off.

The rest of the apps and services on your iPhone will have internet connectivity via mobile data. This means no ads in the game, but normal functionalities for phone, iMessage, WhatsApp notifications, Emails, etc.

Note: You might not see all of your games in step 4 above. This means they likely don’t run ads over Cellular Data.

What if you want to know how to block ads on iPhone without digging into your data plan?

3. Use AdGuard Pro to block ads in games and apps

AdGuard is a popular and efficient ad blocker built for iOS as well as other platforms. This is our ad blocker of choice on Chrome, for example. 

However, we should mention that it’s been a bit of a bumpy ride for AdGurad on iOS. Due to Apple’s guidelines, they’ve seen ups and downs to a point where their app was removed from the App Store for around a year! But, since 2019, it’s back and better than ever! 

The free version of AdGuard limits ads and tracking only inside Safari. But the Pro version ($9.99) claims to do more than that—custom filters and a variety of built-in subscriptions (like EasyPrivacy) offer system-wide ad blocking for apps and games.

You might also want to take a look at VPN apps that have system-wide ad blocking features. Such apps are common on most any platform but tough to find on iOS due to Apple’s strict App Store policies.

Finally, you may want to give Weblock and AdBlock a shot. These are both paid apps at $1.99 a piece, so make sure you do your research on them before pulling the trigger. 

Sometimes these apps work wonders, but with changes in the App Store’s guidelines popping up now and again, they could stop working and may even be removed from the store altogether.

So, try to contact the app developer and buy the app only after you’re satisfied with its offerings. One quick way to reach an app developer is to scroll down the app description and tap App Support. It’ll take you to their official website where you can then email them.

Wrapping up…

Those are the easiest methods to stop ads when playing games or surfing the web on your iPhone. Did any of our solutions work for you? 

Let us know in the comments below, along with any questions you may have regarding Apple devices and accessories.

You may also like to read:

  • How to block websites in Safari on an iPhone, iPad and Mac
  • Block unwanted emails on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
  • How to blocked numbers on iPhone

title.rendered: Best iPhone tripods for filming and photography in 2026

content.rendered:
Considering the fact that a substantial amount of the world has moved online, finding the right tripod is absolutely essential. They not only let you take pictures and videos for content but also stabilize your phone when engaged in meetings. In both cases, professionalism increases and helps you make a good impression.

Keeping these points in mind, I’ve made a list of the best iPhone tripods that you can use today for your business and content needs. Let’s have a look at them below!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Joby GripTight ONE GorillaPod stand – Editor's choice
  • 2. Bluehorn portable iPhone tripod – Best for selfie
  • 3. Lume Cube 18" cordless stand – Best tripod with light
  • 4. Ubeesize tripod with remote – Ultra-portable
  • 5. Geometrical Pocket Tripod Pro – Most compact
  • 6. SmallRig tripod – Bets mini tripod for iPhone
  • 7. BZE extendable selfie stick – Tall iPhone tripod
  • 8. Pivo Pod Lite – AI-powered iPhone stand
  • 9. Linkcool flexible octopus travel pod – Best for solo traveling
  • 10. Joby JB01507 GorillaPod – Versatility champion

1. Joby GripTight ONE GorillaPod stand – Editor’s choice

If you’re looking for a tripod that doesn’t empty your wallet and also provides ease of use, the Joby GripTight ONE GorillaPod Stand is your best bet.

The most important features of the tripod are its flexible legs. These legs can be wrapped around any vertical surface and still maintain peak stability, especially for situations such as astrophotography. Moreover, the tripod is small in stature, adding a portability factor essential for vlogging.

The tripod is compatible with most phones and doesn’t face any issues, even if paired with a large or heavy device. The only thing that I didn’t like about this tripod is that you can’t extend it beyond 6.5 inches. So, if you’re looking for a tripod that also acts as a selfie stick, this may not be for you.

Pros

  • Not too expensive
  • Great build quality
  • Flexible and sturdy legs
  • Portable

Cons

  • Cannot extend beyond 6.5 inches

Check out on: Amazon | Best Buy

2. Bluehorn portable iPhone tripod – Best for selfie

Speaking of iPhone tripods that double as a selfie stick, the Bluehorn portable 40-inch selfie stick is a good option.

When you want to use this as a tripod, you can unfold the legs at the base and place them on a flat surface. For the selfie stick mode, you’ll have to extend the column and fold the legs back into their original position.

There’s a ball head at the top of the column where you can set the phone. This allows you to move the phone freely in any direction. This aspect is particularly useful for content creators as it widens the variety of shots they can take.

There’s also a Bluetooth remote that can be attached to the tripod legs. This enables you to take pictures without having to touch the phone. Unfortunately, once you extend the column, you can’t set it up like a tripod. Attaching the phone at the top makes the entire system heavy and could topple the stick.

Pros

  • Extends up to 40 inches
  • Portable
  • The ball head allows free movement of the camera

Cons

  • Can get unstable

Check out on Amazon

3. Lume Cube 18″ cordless stand – Best tripod with light

With Instagram and YouTube becoming viable sources of business, content creators are always on the lookout for tripods and ring lights. With this offering from Lume Cube, you get the best of both.

This is a full-size tripod that can extend up to 6 feet. Moreover, the ring light has a diameter of 12 inches, which should be enough for providing ample light even in the worst lighting conditions.

Coming to the kit, you can adjust the angle at your convenience. The ring light’s temperature and brightness are also controllable. Best of all, despite the kit’s size, its entirety can be folded and transported. The batteries provided with the kit can be used for over an hour at full brightness.

I’m not happy with this kit’s build quality, though. It’s flimsy, and there have been reports of the phone stand breaking off.

Pros

  • Great for content creators and virtual calls
  • Extends up to 6 feet
  • Ring light temperature and brightness can be adjusted
  • Folds for easy transportation

Cons

  • Build quality is subpar

Check out on Amazon

4. Ubeesize tripod with remote – Ultra-portable

For people always on the go for their content or vlogging purposes, portability becomes a major issue. This is even more pronounced if there are budget constraints. If these statements ring true for you, consider the Ubeesize portable phone tripod.

The tripod weighs just shy of 0.5lbs, and each of the legs is designed in the OCTOPUS style. This implies that the legs of the tripod are flexible and can be wrapped around different surfaces for better angling of shots.

At the bottom of the tripod’s legs, you’ll find ball heads that provide extra grip on flat surfaces. Additionally, the mount at the top can hold smartphones, cameras, and GoPros.

A problem you might face with this tripod, however, is the mediocre Bluetooth remote. Unfortunately, the remote disconnects far too often for my liking.

Pros

  • Highly portable
  • Lightweight
  • Octopus legs are pretty flexible

Cons

  • Bluetooth remote disconnects frequently

Check out on Amazon

5. Geometrical Pocket Tripod Pro – Most compact

This, quite literally, is a tripod that fits into your pocket. While it can’t handle the very intensive tasks, I’ll give you a few reasons as to why you should consider this one.

The tripod’s legs are made of carbon fiber, lending it stability and durability. You don’t have to worry about orientations either, as the mount allows you to tilt the phone to various degrees. This lends the tripod more versatility.

When you fold the tripod, it’ll transform into the shape and size of a card. This makes it so easy to carry around that you can put this into a wallet and forget about the hassle of carrying around a tripod. It’s also compatible and works with phones thinner than 12.5mm.

Despite these great features, I think that this tripod’s rather expensive for what it offers. I’d recommend you keep track of the pricing and buy the tripod at a lower price.

Pros

  • Fits into your pocket
  • Carbon fiber body
  • Offers different orientations for angles and tilts

Cons

  • Expensive

Check out on Amazon

6. SmallRig tripod – Bets mini tripod for iPhone

This mini tripod is meant for professionals who want to control each aspect of their photography or videography.

When you look at the tripod’s design, you’ll see that the legs are inclined at 130 degrees. This is important as any change could upset the tripod’s balance. For progressive panning, the ball head is engraved with different measurements for more accurately angled shots.

The build quality is stunning, with the entire body of the tripod made of aluminum alloy. This lends the tripod an extra level of durability that is difficult to acquire at this size. This heavy-duty body helps the tripod legs to support up to 44lbs of weight.

The rubber padding at the bottom of the legs seems subpar, however. The tripod might slip on smooth and flat surfaces if not fixed properly into place.

Pros

  • Sturdy build quality
  • Can support a lot of weight
  • Perfect for professionals

Cons

  • Rubber padding at legs aren’t great – tripod may slip on some surfaces

Check out on Amazon

7. BZE extendable selfie stick – Tall iPhone tripod

When broadcasting or calling for business, you need a tripod that performs the basics well, isn’t flashy, and won’t cost you an arm and a leg. The BZE extendable selfie stick just might be what you need.

The base of the selfie stick itself has collapsible legs that transform the stick into a tripod. You can shift from one mode to the other with ease.

There’s also a built-in remote control that’s completely wireless. You can click over 1000 photos, thanks to the battery, and the range is up to 10m. This makes it perfect for setting up the tripod for shots with a higher aperture and field of view.

The build quality seems satisfactory, with aluminum alloy and ABS used as the main materials. Moreover, you can extend the stick from 8 inches to 40 inches.

The phone attachment pivot isn’t good, though. You can’t turn it at any angle or tilt with precision. If you’re a professional, this imprecise pivot could hamper your work.

Pros

  • Offers both selfie mode and tripod mode
  • Built-in remote control
  • Good battery backup

Cons

  • Phone attachment doesn’t provide precision

Check out on Amazon

8. Pivo Pod Lite – AI-powered iPhone stand

When you’re making reels or videos, especially those in which you have to talk or feature extensively, your face going out of focus looks highly unprofessional. The Pivo Pod Lite aims to fix this situation.

The iPhone stand is small and can easily be added to your bag when traveling. Once you connect the stand to your phone, it uses artificial intelligence to keep a steady focus on your face. This ensures that your face is focused on at all times.

It also helps make different types of videos, with over 12 Creative Modes to experiment with. That’s right – you can use these creative modes in conjunction with the best photography apps.

The holding space for the phones is a bit narrow, however. If you’ve got a phone with a heavy or thick case, your phone may not fit into the space.

Pros

  • Autofocus assist is a boon
  • Creative modes for extra depth
  • Good build quality

Cons

  • You’ll have to remove the case to fit your iPhone in it

Check out on Amazon

9. Linkcool flexible octopus travel pod – Best for solo traveling

Travel vlogs have become a regular feature on social media platforms. Most seasoned travelers often need a flexible tripod to help them get the precarious shots. If this sounds relatable, you should look at the Linkcool flexible travel pod.

This tripod is compatible with a whole host of phones and cameras. From iPhones to GoPros, this tripod offers plenty of versatility.

The swivel ball head enables you to capture 360-degree shots, and the octopus flexibility of the tripod legs will offer you some mind-boggling angles and orientations for your favorite shot.

There’s also a wireless remote that helps you use the camera remotely, from a range of up to 30 feet. You may face some connectivity issues with the remote, though, as it isn’t completely optimized for various devices.

Pros

  • Universal compatibility
  • Octopus legs flexibility
  • Ball head allows 360-degree shots

Cons

  • Bluetooth remote could have been better

Check out on Amazon

10. Joby JB01507 GorillaPod – Versatility champion

How good would it be if you could attach various peripherals such as lights, mic, and monitors to a tripod? You don’t have to wonder how it’d be like – the Joby JB01507 GorillaPod does exactly that.

The first thing that you notice about this tripod is its build quality. The tripod is sturdy enough to comfortably handle up to 3kg of extra equipment. Moreover, the legs are flexible and can be bent at any angle for more stability on uneven surfaces.

You can also tilt the mount up to 90 degrees and rotate it for a full 360 degrees for a range of videos and photographs.

One thing I would ask you to keep in mind is that this tripod is heavy for its size. While it provides versatility when being used, it’s not travel-friendly.

Pros

  • Versatile with a range of attachments
  • Excellent build quality
  • Offers a lot of orientation options

Cons

  • Heavy for its size

Check out on Amazon

That’s it!

So, what’s your opinion on this list of the best iPhone tripods? Tripods have been on the rise ever since social media became a fad. And honestly, it’s not going away anytime soon.

Have you ever used a tripod? If yes, what do you usually use it for, and what’s your preferred product? Write down your thoughts and opinions in the comment section below!

title.rendered: Best headphones for iPhone in 2026: Picks for every budget

content.rendered:
An iPhone is one of the best smartphones offering above-par features, whether camera or design. However, they don’t boast the best sound quality. So, if you’re looking for the best headphones, this article is for you! I have created this list of headphones considering every budget and different requirements. Let’s get started!

1. AirPods Max – Editor’s choice

  • Noise-canceling: Yes
  • Battery life: Up to 20 hours listening time
  • Charging: Lightning
  • Built-in mic and controls: Yes

Speaking of the AirPods Max, even though they’re quite expensive, they’re still the best wireless headphones for iPhone. Apart from the software optimizations, AirPods Max brings an unparalleled premium quality.

With dynamic drivers for high-quality audio and Active Noise Cancellation, AirPods Max deliver an audiophile experience like no other. The spatial audio feature ensures you get the best possible sound, regardless of the genre you listen to. Additionally, the Transparency mode helps you listen to your surroundings without taking off the headphones.

It also features the revolutionary Apple H1 chip to ensure that your listening experience doesn’t cut any corners, and the audio processing is on par with studio-level headphones. Further, the 20-hour battery life allows you to listen to music without worrying about the battery.

The only major con is its pricing. It’s too expensive for most people.

Pros

  • Great build quality
  • Seamless connectivity with iPhone
  • Active Noise Cancellation and spatial audio
  • Studio-level sound quality

Cons

  • Expensive

Check out on: Amazon | Apple

2. Beats Solo3 – For the bassheads

  • Noise-canceling: Yes
  • Battery life: Up to 40 hours
  • Charging: micro USB
  • Built-in mic and controls: Yes

While Beats may not be the first name for headphones in today’s market, there’s no doubt they have some quality products. One of these is Beats Solo3.

Beats has paired with Apple to manufacture these headphones with the Apple W1 chip. While this is an older processor, it’s the processor that made the first generation of AirPods such a huge success. So, you know that you’re getting one of the best audio processors with this headphone.

Moreover, since Beats has been known for the excellent bass quality in their headphones, the Solo3 is no different. If you’re particular about the bass in their headphones, you must give Solo3 a shot. The deep bass thumping is therapeutic, to say the least.

Lastly, It’s got an exceptional battery life, guaranteed to deliver up to 40 hours of listening time (without ANC and transparency mode). Unfortunately, the case provided with the product isn’t a great fit for headphones, as they’re tight.

Pros

  • Excellent bass production
  • Apple W1 chip for high-quality audio processing
  • Great battery life

Cons

  • Headphones case is too tight

Check out on: Amazon

3. Sony WH-1000XM5 – Light as a feather

  • Noise-canceling: Yes
  • Battery life: Up to 30 hours
  • Charging: USB-C
  • Built-in mic and controls: Yes

Sony WH-1000XM5 is one of the most beautiful and lightweight headphones for iPhone. They come with two processors, one of them being the magnificent Integrated Processor V1. These two processors control 8 different microphones on the headphone, ensuring that you get the best noise cancellation feature.

It also comes with features such as precise voice pickup and advanced audio signal processing to provide an exceptional calling experience. The soft-fit leather used in the headphone’s construction ensures a comfortable and light fit that won’t become a burden after extended use.

Lastly, these headphones also have a quick charging feature. Apart from the 30-hour battery life, you can charge the headphones for just three minutes and get three hours of playback!

However, the fit of the Sony headphones isn’t great if you’re someone who wears spectacles. The tight fit might create a hurdle for wearing your spectacles.

Pros

  • Lightweight yet durable
  • Advanced audio signal processing and precise voice pickup
  • 30-hour battery life
  • Quick charge technology

Cons

  • Not ideal for bespectacled consumers

Check out on: Amazon

4. Audio-Technica ATH-M50X – For studio monitoring

  • Noise-canceling: No
  • Connectivity: Wired

Audio-Technica is almost specifically used by audio engineers for studio production. If you fall into this category and want a new pair of headphones, check out the ATH-M50X.

For the specifics, these headphones come with 45mm audio drivers with rare earth magnets. Additionally, there are copper-clad aluminum wire voice coils as well. In simpler terms, you’re getting premium sound quality without burning a hole in your wallet.

Besides, the headphones’ design is perfect for engineers who want to monitor sounds with one ear. The build quality uses premium materials so that no matter how long you’re listening to music, you won’t face any physical discomfort.

However, the headphones sometimes have issues connecting via Bluetooth with PCs.

Pros

  • 45mm audio drivers for better sound production
  • Perfect for audio engineers and professionals
  • Good build quality

Cons

  • It is wired, so you can’t connect it without Bluetooth

Check out on: Amazon

5. Encased Thore V200 – MFi-certified

  • Noise-canceling: No
  • Connectivity: Wired

You know that a pair of headphones is worth your money if it’s MFi (Made For iPhone) certified. These headphones by Encased provides superior sound quality and is one of the best value-for-money headphones for iPhone.

It comes with a Lightning connector for added convenience and measures at a respectable 4 feet length for more range. Padded ear cushions ensure that you can use the headphones for a long time, along with the 16-point adjustable headband.

The headphones are also RVRB-8 digitally tuned to provide the most accurate sound possible. Moreover, the Thore V200 comes with 50mm audio drivers and neodymium magnets to provide coverage over a large frequency range. Lastly, you get a one-year warranty with the product!

Unfortunately, the quality of the provided Lightning connector isn’t all that great.

Pros

  • 50mm audio drivers for crisp audio
  • MFi-certified
  • Lightning connector provided
  • 1-year warranty

Cons

  • Lightning connector quality could be better

Check out on: Amazon

6. pollini – Exceptional battery life

  • Noise-canceling: No
  • Battery life: Up to 30 hours
  • Charging: micro USB
  • Built-in mic and controls: Yes

Want to listen to music throughout the day but can’t splurge on the headphones with good battery life? This product by pollini is the solution to your problems.

The headphones come with an impressive 40-hour battery life powered by an 800mAh battery. If your battery runs out at an inopportune moment, you can always use an audio cable to switch to the wired mode. Moreover, your long listening hours will be spent in comfort, thanks to the padded design and user-friendly build.

This product also features 40mm neodymium drivers to ensure that you get a clear and crisp sound quality, regardless of your preference in music. It performs well for all genres, from hard rock to house music. Finally, you also get a year’s warranty with the product!

Although the headphones provide an accurate sound, it doesn’t get too loud. That can be an issue if you like listening to your music at higher volumes.

Pros

  • 40-hour battery life
  • User-friendly build
  • Good sound quality
  • One year warranty

Cons

  • Not very loud

Check out on: Amazon

7. Sony Over-Ear – Best for tight budgets

  • Noise-canceling: No
  • Connectivity: Wired

This pair of Sony headphones may not look like the latest deal or have the latest features. However, if you want a pair of headphones that do the basics well and come at an affordable price, you should go for this product.

The headphones provide extra stereo bass, thanks to the high-energy neodymium drivers used in the build. Additionally, the swivel design for the headphones makes them easier to operate if you want to listen with one ear. Overall, while you don’t get the newest features or looks with these headphones, they get the fundamentals right!

It isn’t a comfortable pair of headphones, though. If comfort is high on your level of priorities, you should look elsewhere.

Pros

  • Affordable
  • Does the fundamentals well

Cons

  • Not comfortable

Check out on: Amazon

8. Anker Soundcore Life Q20 – Noise cancellation on a budget

  • Noise-canceling: Yes
  • Battery life: Up to 60 hours
  • Charging: micro USB
  • Built-in mic and controls: Yes

As we all know, noise cancellation is often a feature exclusive to premium headphones. With the Soundcore Life Q20 by Anker, you don’t have to spend extravagant money to get this feature.

The headphones provide you with Hi-Res sound produced by high-quality 40mm drivers. Moreover, the patented BassUp technology analyzes low-frequency audio to produce more pronounced bass.

The Q20 also has a digital active noise cancellation algorithm powered by 4 built-in ANC microphones. Additionally, you also get a battery life of 40 to 60 hours with the headphones, based on the mode you use.

However, you can’t charge the headphones and listen to music simultaneously.

Pros

  • Excellent sound quality
  • Noise Cancellation with 4 mics
  • 40 to 60 hours of battery life

Cons

  • Earcups are insulative

Check out on: Amazon | Soundcore

9. Bose Noise Canceling Headphones 700 – Built-in Alexa

  • Noise-canceling: Yes
  • Battery life: Up to 20 hours
  • Charging: USB-C
  • Built-in mic and controls: Yes

For every audiophile, Bose is one of the biggest names on the list. Whether it’s speakers or headphones, there’s no doubt about the premium quality Bose brings to the table.

With the noise-canceling headphones 700, Bose has provided an elegant, minimalist, premium set of headphones with a built-in Alexa. You can use Alexa to stay connected with your phone with ultimate ease.

Furthermore, a single charge will deliver you 20 hours of battery life. While this isn’t the greatest, the sound quality will compensate more than enough. Unfortunately, the headphones are quite expensive, even for the multitude of features that it comes with.

Pros

  • Built-in Alexa
  • Elegant design

Cons

  • Expensive for the features

Check out on: Amazon

10. SAMSUNG AKG Y500 – Decent build quality

  • Noise-canceling: No
  • Battery life: Up to 33 hours
  • Charging: micro USB
  • Built-in mic and controls: Yes

If you tend to drop your headphones, these Samsung headphones are what you need. The AKG Y500 has a build quality that will ensure long-lasting service.

It also features some great connectivity options. You can pair it with two Bluetooth devices simultaneously, and the headphones will intuitively switch between them based on your requirements.

Additionally, it comes with a 33-hour battery life that also features quick charging support. Additionally, 5 minutes of charge will provide an extra hour of playback. Finally, the AKG Y500 also comes with play and pause automation to save battery life. The music plays and pauses automatically based on whether you’ve put them over your ears or not.

Unfortunately, the fit of the headphones isn’t the best. It might slip off if you’re moving around too much.

Pros

  • Exceptional build quality
  • 33-hour battery life
  • Good Bluetooth connectivity options
  • Play and pause automation

Cons

  • Fit isn’t ideal for most users

Check out on: Amazon

FAQs

Are iPhone headphones good for gaming?

Yes. Although these headphones for iPhone won’t provide the ambient lighting features you’d expect in a gaming setup, they will get the job done. After all, sound quality is what matters most. These headphones provide that in spades.

How to make headphones louder on iPhone?

If you’ve connected the headphones to the iPhone, you can turn up the volume by using the iPhone’s volume rockers. Some headphones also have volume rockers on their build, with physical or touch buttons.

How to turn off headphone safety on iPhone?

To turn off headphone safety on iPhone: go to iPhone Settings → tap Sound u0026 Haptics → go to the Headphone Safety section → toggle off Reduce Loud Sounds.

Summing up

So, these were the best headphones for iPhone. I’ve tried to segregate them based on price and requirements. I hope this guide helped you pick your next headphones. If your favorite wasn’t added to this list, share them in the comment section! I will certainly test and add them too.
